```py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DonorPCIeIPConfig:
    """Optional donor PCIe IP CONFIG values beyond the five identification IDs.

    Every field is optional. A ``None`` value means "the donor profile did not
    expose this; leave the Xilinx IP default in place." That keeps the override
    safe when the donor profile is partial (e.g. an older capture without DSN).

    Field labels (A4, A5, ...) match the coverage list in the module docstring.
    """

    # A4 — Class Code (24-bit, packed base/sub/interface)
    class_code: Optional[int] = None

    # A8 — Max Payload Size (DevCap.MPS in bytes: 128/256/512/1024/2048/4096)
    max_payload_size: Optional[int] = None

    # A7 — LinkCap negotiated ceiling
    link_speed: Optional[int] = None  # PCIe gen: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (mapped to spec)
    link_speed_code: Optional[int] = None  # Spec-encoded value 1/2/4/8/16 (direct)
    link_width: Optional[int] = None  # Lane count 1/2/4/8/16

    # A6 — MSI-X capability advertisement, independent of capture-time Enable
    msix_enabled: Optional[bool] = None
    msix_table_size: Optional[int] = None  # number of vectors (1..2048)
    msix_table_bir: Optional[int] = None  # 0..5
    msix_table_offset: Optional[int] = None
    msix_pba_bir: Optional[int] = None  # 0..5
    msix_pba_offset: Optional[int] = None

    # C1 / C3 — Capability enables
    aer_enabled: Optional[bool] = None
    ari_forwarding_supported: Optional[bool] = None

    # D2 — Completion-timeout policy (DevCap2 bits 3:0, as a range-letter token).
    # Representable: "A", "B", "AB", "BC", "ABC", "BCD", "ABCD" (see
    # _CPL_TIMEOUT_RANGE_ENUMS). "none" (0000b) and the reserved "C"/"D"
    # encodings have no Vivado enum and are rejected, never approximated.
    cpl_timeout_ranges: Optional[str] = None
    cpl_timeout_disable_supported: Optional[bool] = None
    extended_tag_supported: Optional[bool] = None

    # C2 — Device Serial Number (64-bit; emitted as two 32-bit halves into the IP)
    dsn_value: Optional[int] = None

    # A5 — served BAR aperture, presented as config-space BAR0 (the only window
    # the PCILeech controller services). Setting bar_aperture_size enables the
    # block; the rest default sensibly.
    bar_aperture_size: Optional[int] = None  # bytes, power of 2
    bar_is_memory: Optional[bool] = None  # True=Memory (default), False=IO
    bar_is_64bit: Optional[bool] = None  # memory only; consumes the next slot
    bar_prefetchable: Optional[bool] = None  # memory only
    bar_index: Optional[int] = None  # donor PCI BAR index N the device serves
    # Explicit register/MSI-X served set. Scalars above remain the register BAR
    # compatibility view; empty keeps the historical single-BAR path.
    served_bars: tuple[ServedBar, ...] = ()


_OVERRIDE_FILENAME = "pcileech_donor_ip_overrides.tcl"


def generate_pcie_ip_override_tcl(
    donor: DonorIDs,
    *,
    ip_name: str = "pcie_7x_0",
    extra: "DonorPCIeIPConfig | None" = None,
    requester_policy: Optional[RequesterTrackingPolicy] = None,
) -> str:
    """Render the donor-ID CONFIG override as a Vivado TCL string.

    Exactly one IP must match ``ip_name``; a missing or ambiguous IP raises a
    Tcl error instead of building with stock Xilinx values. Optional ``extra``
    contributes additional ``CONFIG.<key> <value>`` lines for fields the
    donor profile exposed (class code, MPS, MSI-X, LinkCap, AER, ARI,
    cpl-timeout, DSN — see ``DonorPCIeIPConfig``).

    Identity, ``CONFIG.Bar*``, ``CONFIG.MSIx_*`` and ``CONFIG.Cpl_Timeout_*``
    are mandatory: a setter failure raises, and after every write their
    effective values are read back with ``get_property`` so an ignored or
    later-reverted value also raises. Other fields only warn when the core
    does not expose them.

    A source-bound qualified requester policy may establish the donor's final
    Disable Supported=true through reset-held DRP when IP-initial readback is
    false. Only that mismatch is delegated; setters and all other readbacks stay
    mandatory. The exact live target and selected source hashes are checked.
    """
    # The 7-series PCIe core stores these ID fields as bare hexadecimal strings
    # (the stock .xci holds "10EE"/"0666", and Vivado 2026.1 rejects a 0x
    # prefix: "Entered invalid Hexadecimal value 0x1E4B"). Emit bare uppercase
    # hex, matching the GUI and the other hex fields (Class_Code_*, DSN_*).
    #
    # Identity-critical fields: if any of these fail to apply, the IP would
    # regenerate with the stock Xilinx identity (10EE:0666). That is the
    # placeholder-donor-ID anti-pattern the project forbids, so a failure here
    # must abort the build rather than warn — the rest of the fields may be
    # skipped (see below), but identity never silently falls back.
    id_lines: list[str] = [
        f"CONFIG.Vendor_ID {donor.vendor_id:04X}",
        f"CONFIG.Device_ID {donor.device_id:04X}",
        f"CONFIG.Subsystem_Vendor_ID {donor.subsystem_vendor_id:04X}",
        f"CONFIG.Subsystem_ID {donor.subsystem_id:04X}",
        f"CONFIG.Revision_ID {donor.revision_id:02X}",
    ]
    extra_lines = _format_extra_config_lines(extra) if extra is not None else []

    # Apply each property individually under catch rather than one atomic
    # set_property -dict: the 7-series core renames/removes some parameters
    # between Vivado versions (e.g. 2026.1 drops DSN_HEX1/2 and
    # LINK_CAP_MAX_LINK_SPEED/WIDTH), and an atomic dict aborts the whole
    # override — including the critical donor IDs — on the first unknown key.
    # The optional block only warns about parameters this core version does not
    # expose; the identity block above aborts.
    id_block = "\n".join(f"        {line}" for line in id_lines)
    extra_block = "\n".join(f"        {line}" for line in extra_lines)
    check_block = "\n".join(
        f"dict set _pcileech_required {key} {kind}"
        for key, kind in _mandatory_checks(id_lines + extra_lines, extra)
    )
    mismatch = (
        "        lappend _pcileech_mismatch "
        '"$_pcileech_k (expected $_pcileech_v, got $_pcileech_actual)"\n'
    )
    if requester_policy is not None:
        requester_policy = RequesterTrackingPolicy.model_validate(
            requester_policy.model_dump()
        )
        qualification = requester_policy.startup_qualification
        if qualification is not None:
            if extra is None or (
                extra.cpl_timeout_ranges != requester_policy.cpl_timeout_ranges
                or extra.cpl_timeout_disable_supported
                != requester_policy.cpl_timeout_disable_supported
                or extra.extended_tag_supported
                != requester_policy.extended_tag_supported
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Qualified requester policy disagrees with donor override"
                )
            guard = startup_qualification_guard_tcl(
                qualification, ip_variable="$_pcileech_ip"
            )
            mismatch = (
                "        if {$_pcileech_k eq {CONFIG.Cpl_Timeout_Disable_Sup} && "
                "[_pcileech_value_matches bool true $_pcileech_v] && "
                "[_pcileech_value_matches bool false $_pcileech_actual]} {\n"
                + guard
                + "        } else {\n"
                + mismatch
                + "        }\n"
            )

    return (
        "# === PCILeechFWGenerator donor-ID override (issue #593) ===\n"
        f"{_VALUE_MATCH_PROC}"
        f"set _pcileech_ips [get_ips -quiet {ip_name}]\n"
        "if {[llength $_pcileech_ips] != 1} {\n"
        f'    error "PCILeechFWGenerator: expected exactly one PCIe IP named '
        f"{ip_name}, found [llength $_pcileech_ips] — refusing to build "
        'firmware without the donor IP override"\n'
        "}\n"
        "set _pcileech_ip [lindex $_pcileech_ips 0]\n"
        "# Mandatory keys and how their read-back value is compared.\n"
        "set _pcileech_required [dict create]\n"
        f"{check_block}\n"
        "set _pcileech_expected [dict create]\n"
        "set _pcileech_failed {}\n"
        "set _pcileech_id_failed {}\n"
        "# Identity first, then the donor fields in emission order. Mandatory\n"
        "# setter failures abort; optional / version-variant fields only warn.\n"
        "foreach {_pcileech_k _pcileech_v} {\n"
        f"{id_block}\n"
        f"{extra_block}\n"
        "} {\n"
        "    dict set _pcileech_expected $_pcileech_k $_pcileech_v\n"
        "    if {[catch {set_property $_pcileech_k $_pcileech_v "
        "$_pcileech_ip} _pcileech_err]} {\n"
        "        if {[dict exists $_pcileech_required $_pcileech_k]} {\n"
        '            lappend _pcileech_id_failed "$_pcileech_k ($_pcileech_err)"\n'
        "        } else {\n"
        '            lappend _pcileech_failed "$_pcileech_k ($_pcileech_err)"\n'
        "        }\n"
        "    }\n"
        "}\n"
        "if {[llength $_pcileech_failed] > 0} {\n"
        '    puts "WARNING: PCILeechFWGenerator donor override skipped '
        "[llength $_pcileech_failed] unsupported IP parameter(s): "
        '[join $_pcileech_failed {; }]"\n'
        "}\n"
        "if {[llength $_pcileech_id_failed] > 0} {\n"
        '    error "PCILeechFWGenerator: mandatory donor IP override failed on '
        "[join $_pcileech_id_failed {; }] — refusing to build firmware with "
        'stock Xilinx IDs or layout"\n'
        "}\n"
        "# Read back after ALL writes: catches a value the core accepted but\n"
        "# ignored, or one a later optional write reverted.\n"
        "set _pcileech_mismatch {}\n"
        "dict for {_pcileech_k _pcileech_kind} $_pcileech_required {\n"
        "    set _pcileech_v [dict get $_pcileech_expected $_pcileech_k]\n"
        "    if {[catch {get_property $_pcileech_k $_pcileech_ip} "
        "_pcileech_actual]} {\n"
        "        lappend _pcileech_mismatch "
        '"$_pcileech_k (read-back failed: $_pcileech_actual)"\n'
        "    } elseif {![_pcileech_value_matches $_pcileech_kind $_pcileech_v "
        "$_pcileech_actual]} {\n"
        f"{mismatch}"
        "    }\n"
        "}\n"
        "if {[llength $_pcileech_mismatch] > 0} {\n"
        '    error "PCILeechFWGenerator: mandatory donor IP read-back mismatch '
        "on [join $_pcileech_mismatch {; }] — refusing to build firmware with "
        'stock Xilinx IDs or layout"\n'
        "}\n"
        f"generate_target -force all [get_ips {ip_name}]\n"
    )


_IDENTITY_KEYS = frozenset(
    {
        "CONFIG.Vendor_ID",
        "CONFIG.Device_ID",
        "CONFIG.Subsystem_Vendor_ID",
        "CONFIG.Subsystem_ID",
        "CONFIG.Revision_ID",
        "CONFIG.Class_Code_Base",
        "CONFIG.Class_Code_Sub",
        "CONFIG.Class_Code_Interface",
    }
)
_MSIX_BIR_KEYS = frozenset({"CONFIG.MSIx_Table_BIR", "CONFIG.MSIx_PBA_BIR"})


def validate_donor_ip_build_config(extra: "DonorPCIeIPConfig | None") -> None:
    """Reject incomplete production configuration before emitting an override.

    Low-level rendering supports partial fragments for tooling, but a firmware
    build must never interpret absent class/BAR values as stock defaults.
    """
    if extra is None or extra.class_code is None:
        raise PcieIpOverrideError("Donor class code is missing or invalid")
    if not 0 <= extra.class_code <= 0xFFFFFF:
        raise PcieIpOverrideError("Donor class code is outside its 24-bit range")
    if extra.bar_aperture_size is None:
        raise PcieIpOverrideError(
            "Served BAR is missing or has an unsupported aperture"
        )
    reason = _bar_aperture_error(
        extra.bar_aperture_size, extra.bar_is_memory is not False
    )
    if reason:
        raise PcieIpOverrideError(reason)


def _is_mandatory_key(key: str) -> bool:
    return (
        key in _IDENTITY_KEYS
        or key.startswith("CONFIG.Bar")
        or key.startswith("CONFIG.MSIx_")
        # Emitted only when the donor reports a representable policy, so a
        # rejected or ignored write is a fidelity failure, not a version skew.
        or key.startswith("CONFIG.Cpl_Timeout_")
        or key == "CONFIG.Extended_Tag_Field"
    )


def _mandatory_checks(
    lines: "list[str]", extra: "DonorPCIeIPConfig | None"
) -> "list[tuple[str, str]]":
    """Return ``(key, kind)`` for each mandatory key, in first-write order.

    ``kind`` selects the read-back comparison: ``hex`` (bare-hex IDs), ``bool``,
    ``dec`` (integers), ``bar`` / ``bar64`` (MSI-X BIR tokens) or ``token``.
    """
    pair_lower = None
    if extra is not None and extra.bar_aperture_size is not None:
        is_memory = extra.bar_is_memory is None or bool(extra.bar_is_memory)
        if is_memory and extra.bar_is_64bit:
            pair_lower = 0 if extra.bar_index is None else extra.bar_index

    checks: "dict[str, str]" = {}
    for line in lines:
        key, value = line.split(None, 1)
        if not _is_mandatory_key(key) or key in checks:
            continue
        if key in _IDENTITY_KEYS:
            kind = "hex"
        elif key in _MSIX_BIR_KEYS:
            # A 64-bit pair can read back as BAR_<N+1>:<N>; only the lower BAR
            # of that pair is verified.
            kind = "bar64" if value == f"BAR_{pair_lower}" else "bar"
        elif value in ("true", "false"):
            kind = "bool"
        elif value.isdigit():
            kind = "dec"
        else:
            kind = "token"
        checks[key] = kind
    return list(checks.items())


# Tcl comparison for mandatory read-back. Accepts case/spelling-normalized
# booleans, numerically equal values (with or without 0x / leading zeros), and
# the 64-bit MSI-X BIR pair form BAR_<hi>:<lo> whose lower BAR is expected.
_VALUE_MATCH_PROC = r"""proc _pcileech_parse_int {text radix} {
    set text [string trim $text]
    if {[regexp -nocase {^0x([0-9a-f]+)$} $text -> digits]} {
        return [scan $digits %x]
    }
    if {$radix eq "hex" && [regexp -nocase {^[0-9a-f]+$} $text]} {
        return [scan $text %x]
    }
    if {[regexp {^[0-9]+$} $text]} {
        return [scan $text %d]
    }
    return {}
}
proc _pcileech_value_matches {kind expected actual} {
    set actual [string trim $actual]
    if {[string equal -nocase $expected $actual]} {
        return 1
    }
    switch -- $kind {
        hex - dec {
            set e [_pcileech_parse_int $expected $kind]
            set a [_pcileech_parse_int $actual $kind]
            return [expr {$e ne {} && $a ne {} && $e == $a}]
        }
        bool {
            if {![string is boolean -strict $actual]} {
                return 0
            }
            return [expr {[string is true $expected] == [string is true $actual]}]
        }
        bar64 {
            if {[regexp -nocase {^BAR_([0-9]+)$} $expected -> want] &&
                [regexp -nocase {^BAR_[0-9]+:([0-9]+)$} $actual -> lower]} {
                return [expr {[scan $lower %d] == [scan $want %d]}]
            }
            return 0
        }
        default {
            return 0
        }
    }
}
"""


_XILINX_BAR_SCALES = (
    ("Gigabytes", 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    ("Megabytes", 1024 * 1024),
    ("Kilobytes", 1024),
    ("Bytes", 1),
)


def _bytes_to_xilinx_scale_size(size_bytes: int) -> "tuple[str, int]":
    """Map a byte size to the 7-series IP's ``(Scale, Size)`` token pair.

    Picks the largest scale that divides ``size_bytes`` evenly so the numeric
    multiplier stays below 1024 — the same Scale/Size split the Vivado IP GUI
    uses (e.g. 2 MiB is ``Megabytes 2``, never ``Kilobytes 2048``).
    """
    for scale, unit in _XILINX_BAR_SCALES:
        if size_bytes % unit == 0:
            return (scale, size_bytes // unit)
    # Unreachable: the ("Bytes", 1) tier divides every integer.
    raise ValueError(f"cannot encode BAR size {size_bytes} bytes")


_MPS_TOKENS = {
    128: "128_bytes",
    256: "256_bytes",
    512: "512_bytes",
    1024: "1024_bytes",
    2048: "2048_bytes",
    4096: "4096_bytes",
}

_LINK_SPEED_ENCODING = {1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 4, 4: 8, 5: 16}
_VALID_LINK_WIDTHS = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)

# DevCap2 Completion Timeout Ranges Supported (bits 3:0; bit0=A .. bit3=D) ->
# the exact Cpl_Timeout_Range enum the 7-series core accepts. Spellings are
# taken verbatim from Vivado 2026.1's own rejection message (IP_Flow 19-3461):
#   Range_A, Range_B, Ranges_A_&_B, Ranges_B_&_C, Ranges_A,_B_&_C,
#   Ranges_B,_C_&_D, Ranges_A,_B,_C_&_D
# These are exactly the non-zero, non-reserved encodings the PCIe Base Spec
# defines for this field.
_CPL_TIMEOUT_RANGE_ENUMS = {
    "A": "Range_A",  # 0001b
    "B": "Range_B",  # 0010b
    "AB": "Ranges_A_&_B",  # 0011b
    "BC": "Ranges_B_&_C",  # 0110b
    "ABC": "Ranges_A,_B_&_C",  # 0111b
    "BCD": "Ranges_B,_C_&_D",  # 1110b
    "ABCD": "Ranges_A,_B,_C_&_D",  # 1111b
}
# Genuine donor encodings the core has no enum for. Emitting any enum here
# would advertise ranges the donor does not report.
_CPL_TIMEOUT_RANGE_UNREPRESENTABLE = {
    "none": "0000b (ranges not supported) has no Cpl_Timeout_Range enum",
    "C": "0100b is a reserved DevCap2 encoding with no Cpl_Timeout_Range enum",
    "D": "1000b is a reserved DevCap2 encoding with no Cpl_Timeout_Range enum",
    **{
        f"reserved:{bits:04b}": (
            f"{bits:04b} is a reserved DevCap2 encoding with no Cpl_Timeout_Range enum"
        )
        for bits in (5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13)
    },
}


def cpl_timeout_range_enum(token: str) -> str:
    """Map a donor range token to its Vivado ``Cpl_Timeout_Range`` enum.

    Raises ``CplTimeoutRangeUnrepresentableError`` for a genuine donor encoding
    the core cannot advertise, and plain ``ValueError`` for a malformed token.
    """
    enum = _CPL_TIMEOUT_RANGE_ENUMS.get(token)
    if enum is not None:
        return enum
    reason = _CPL_TIMEOUT_RANGE_UNREPRESENTABLE.get(token)
    if reason is not None:
        raise CplTimeoutRangeUnrepresentableError(
            f"cpl_timeout_ranges {token!r} cannot be represented on the "
            f"7-series PCIe IP: {reason}"
        )
    raise ValueError(
        f"cpl_timeout_ranges {token!r} is not a PCIe completion-timeout range "
        f"token (supported: {sorted(_CPL_TIMEOUT_RANGE_ENUMS)}; "
        f"unrepresentable: {sorted(_CPL_TIMEOUT_RANGE_UNREPRESENTABLE)})"
    )


def _tcl_bool(value: bool) -> str:
    return "true" if value else "false"


def _format_extra_config_lines(extra: "DonorPCIeIPConfig") -> list[str]:
    """Return one ``CONFIG.<key> <value>`` string per non-None field in *extra*."""
    out: list[str] = []

    if extra.class_code is not None:
        if not (0 <= extra.class_code <= 0xFFFFFF):
            raise ValueError(
                f"class_code 0x{extra.class_code:X} does not fit in 24 bits"
            )
        base = (extra.class_code >> 16) & 0xFF
        sub = (extra.class_code >> 8) & 0xFF
        interface = extra.class_code & 0xFF
        out.append(f"CONFIG.Class_Code_Base {base:02X}")
        out.append(f"CONFIG.Class_Code_Sub {sub:02X}")
        out.append(f"CONFIG.Class_Code_Interface {interface:02X}")

    if extra.max_payload_size is not None:
        token = _MPS_TOKENS.get(extra.max_payload_size)
        if token is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"max_payload_size {extra.max_payload_size} is not one of "
                f"{sorted(_MPS_TOKENS)}"
            )
        out.append(f"CONFIG.Max_Payload_Size {token}")

    if extra.link_speed is not None and extra.link_speed_code is not None:
        raise ValueError(
            "set exactly one of link_speed (generation) or "
            "link_speed_code (spec-encoded), not both"
        )
    if extra.link_speed is not None:
        encoded = _LINK_SPEED_ENCODING.get(extra.link_speed)
        if encoded is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"link_speed {extra.link_speed} is not a valid PCIe generation "
                f"(supported: {sorted(_LINK_SPEED_ENCODING)})"
            )
        out.append(f"CONFIG.LINK_CAP_MAX_LINK_SPEED {encoded}")
    elif extra.link_speed_code is not None:
        if extra.link_speed_code not in _LINK_SPEED_ENCODING.values():
            raise ValueError(
                f"link_speed_code {extra.link_speed_code} is not a valid PCIe "
                f"spec encoding (supported: {sorted(_LINK_SPEED_ENCODING.values())})"
            )
        out.append(f"CONFIG.LINK_CAP_MAX_LINK_SPEED {extra.link_speed_code}")

    if extra.link_width is not None:
        if extra.link_width not in _VALID_LINK_WIDTHS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"link_width {extra.link_width} is not one of {_VALID_LINK_WIDTHS}"
            )
        out.append(f"CONFIG.LINK_CAP_MAX_LINK_WIDTH {extra.link_width}")

    # BAR apertures before the MSI-X layout: the core only accepts
    # MSIx_Table_BIR/MSIx_PBA_BIR values naming an enabled BAR, so a table in
    # BAR3 must follow Bar3_Enabled (IP_Flow 19-3461 otherwise).
    out.extend(_format_bar_aperture_lines(extra))

    if extra.msix_enabled is not None:
        if not extra.msix_enabled:
            out.append("CONFIG.MSIx_Enabled false")
        else:
            # When enabled, the full layout must be present — partial state
            # makes the IP synthesize with default offsets and the donor's
            # advertised offsets disagree → driver mmap mismatch.
            required = {
                "msix_table_size": extra.msix_table_size,
                "msix_table_bir": extra.msix_table_bir,
                "msix_table_offset": extra.msix_table_offset,
                "msix_pba_bir": extra.msix_pba_bir,
                "msix_pba_offset": extra.msix_pba_offset,
            }
            missing = [name for name, value in required.items() if value is None]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(
                    "msix_enabled=True requires the full MSI-X layout; missing: "
                    + ", ".join(missing)
                )
            # `missing` above proves every required field is set.
            table_size = cast(int, extra.msix_table_size)
            if table_size < 1 or table_size > 2048:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"msix_table_size {table_size} outside spec range 1..2048"
                )
            for label, bir in (
                ("msix_table_bir", cast(int, extra.msix_table_bir)),
                ("msix_pba_bir", cast(int, extra.msix_pba_bir)),
            ):
                if not (0 <= bir <= 5):
                    raise ValueError(f"{label} {bir} is not a valid BAR index (0..5)")

            out.append("CONFIG.MSIx_Enabled true")
            out.append(f"CONFIG.MSIx_Table_Size {extra.msix_table_size}")
            out.append(f"CONFIG.MSIx_Table_BIR BAR_{extra.msix_table_bir}")
            out.append(f"CONFIG.MSIx_Table_Offset {extra.msix_table_offset}")
            out.append(f"CONFIG.MSIx_PBA_BIR BAR_{extra.msix_pba_bir}")
            out.append(f"CONFIG.MSIx_PBA_Offset {extra.msix_pba_offset}")

    if extra.aer_enabled is not None:
        out.append(f"CONFIG.AER_Enabled {_tcl_bool(extra.aer_enabled)}")

    if extra.ari_forwarding_supported is not None:
        out.append(
            f"CONFIG.ARI_Forwarding_Supported {_tcl_bool(extra.ari_forwarding_supported)}"
        )

    if extra.cpl_timeout_ranges is not None:
        enum = cpl_timeout_range_enum(extra.cpl_timeout_ranges)
        out.append(f"CONFIG.Cpl_Timeout_Range {enum}")

    if extra.cpl_timeout_disable_supported is not None:
        out.append(
            f"CONFIG.Cpl_Timeout_Disable_Sup {_tcl_bool(extra.cpl_timeout_disable_supported)}"
        )

    if extra.extended_tag_supported is not None:
        out.append(
            f"CONFIG.Extended_Tag_Field {_tcl_bool(extra.extended_tag_supported)}"
        )

    if extra.dsn_value is not None:
        if not (0 <= extra.dsn_value <= 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF):
            raise ValueError(f"dsn_value 0x{extra.dsn_value:X} does not fit in 64 bits")
        lower = extra.dsn_value & 0xFFFFFFFF
        upper = (extra.dsn_value >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        out.append(f"CONFIG.DSN_HEX1 {lower:08X}")
        out.append(f"CONFIG.DSN_HEX2 {upper:08X}")

    return out


def _bar_aperture_error(size: int, is_memory: bool) -> "str | None":
    """Return an error string if *size* can't be a valid BAR aperture, else None.

    Shared by the emitter (which raises on explicit misuse) and the extractor
    (which skips defensively, leaving the IP default rather than failing a build).
    """
    bar_type = "memory" if is_memory else "io"
    result = get_bar_size_validator(bar_type=bar_type).validate(size)
    if not result.valid:
        return (
            f"BAR aperture size {size} is invalid for a {bar_type} BAR: "
            + "; ".join(result.errors)
        )
    # Sub-page memory apertures wrap in the hard block; PCILeech's own guidance
    # is to never go below 4 KiB for the served memory BAR.
    if is_memory and size < 4096:
        return f"BAR aperture size {size} below the 4 KiB floor for a memory BAR"
    return None


_NUM_STANDARD_BARS = 6  # BAR0..BAR5


def _format_bar_aperture_lines(extra: "DonorPCIeIPConfig") -> list[str]:
    """Emit exact apertures for the register BAR and optional MSI-X BAR.

    The device register window is served at the donor's REAL PCI BAR index N
    (``bar_index``) — the controller gates its impl on rd_req_bar[N]/wr_bar[N]
    to match. IO BARs cannot be 64-bit or prefetchable, so those flags are
    coerced off. Every other standard BAR index is force-disabled (including the
    .xci default BAR0 when N != 0) so the host enumerates exactly the one served
    window — no phantom BARs, and no BAR the controller answers with ``none``
    (which would hang reads). A 64-bit BAR consumes index N+1, which falls into
    the disabled set automatically.
    """
    if extra.served_bars:
        served = served_bars_from_config({"served_bars": extra.served_bars}) or ()
        lines: list[str] = []
        for bar in served:
            single = replace(
                extra,
                served_bars=(),
                bar_index=bar.index,
                bar_aperture_size=bar.size,
                bar_is_memory=bar.is_memory,
                bar_is_64bit=bar.is_64bit,
                bar_prefetchable=bar.prefetchable,
            )
            lines.extend(
                line
                for line in _format_bar_aperture_lines(single)
                if not line.endswith("_Enabled false")
            )
        enabled = {bar.index for bar in served}
        lines.extend(
            f"CONFIG.Bar{k}_Enabled false"
            for k in range(_NUM_STANDARD_BARS)
            if k not in enabled
        )
        return lines
    if extra.bar_aperture_size is None:
        return []

    size = extra.bar_aperture_size
    is_memory = True if extra.bar_is_memory is None else bool(extra.bar_is_memory)

    error = _bar_aperture_error(size, is_memory)
    if error is not None:
        raise ValueError(error)

    n = 0 if extra.bar_index is None else extra.bar_index
    if not (0 <= n < _NUM_STANDARD_BARS):
        raise ValueError(f"bar_index {n} is not a standard BAR index (0..5)")

    is_64bit = bool(extra.bar_is_64bit) and is_memory
    if is_64bit and n == _NUM_STANDARD_BARS - 1:
        # The upper half would land on BAR6 (Expansion ROM), not a standard
        # BAR — electrically invalid PCI.
        raise ValueError(
            f"bar_index {n} cannot be 64-bit: the upper-half partner would be "
            "BAR6 (Expansion ROM), not a standard BAR"
        )
    prefetchable = bool(extra.bar_prefetchable) and is_memory
    scale, multiplier = _bytes_to_xilinx_scale_size(size)

    lines = [
        f"CONFIG.Bar{n}_Enabled true",
        f"CONFIG.Bar{n}_Type {'Memory' if is_memory else 'IO'}",
        f"CONFIG.Bar{n}_64bit {_tcl_bool(is_64bit)}",
        f"CONFIG.Bar{n}_Prefetchable {_tcl_bool(prefetchable)}",
        f"CONFIG.Bar{n}_Scale {scale}",
        f"CONFIG.Bar{n}_Size {multiplier}",
    ]
    # Disable every other standard BAR (incl. the 64-bit partner at N+1).
    lines.extend(
        f"CONFIG.Bar{k}_Enabled false" for k in range(_NUM_STANDARD_BARS) if k != n
    )
    return lines


def apply_pcie_ip_donor_override(
    staging_dir: Path,
    donor: DonorIDs,
    *,
    ip_name: str = "pcie_7x_0",
    extra: "DonorPCIeIPConfig | None" = None,
    requester_policy: Optional[RequesterTrackingPolicy] = None,
) -> dict:
    """Write the override TCL into the Stage 2 output.

    Returns a summary dict with ``override_path``, the emitted override TCL.
    """
    override_path = Path(staging_dir) / _OVERRIDE_FILENAME
    override_path.write_text(
        generate_pcie_ip_override_tcl(
            donor, ip_name=ip_name, extra=extra, requester_policy=requester_policy
        )
    )
    return {"override_path": override_path}


def _coerce_bool(value) -> Optional[bool]:
    """Best-effort bool coercion: accept True/False/1/0/"true"/"false"."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return bool(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        s = value.strip().lower()
        if s in ("true", "1", "yes"):
            return True
        if s in ("false", "0", "no"):
            return False
    return None


def donor_pcie_ip_config_from_result(result: dict) -> "DonorPCIeIPConfig":
    """Build a DonorPCIeIPConfig from the build's ``result`` dict.

    Missing optional fields leave IP defaults unchanged. MSI-X is different:
    a present capability is explicitly disabled unless the generation-time
    decision (``template_context["msix_subsystem"]``, see
    ``device_clone.msix_subsystem``) generated the subsystem. Capture-time
    Enable is runtime state.
    """
    template_context = (result or {}).get("template_context") or {}
    device_config = template_context.get("device_config") or {}

    class_code = _coerce_int(device_config.get("class_code"))
    # Canonical producer path: template_context["pcileech_config"]["max_payload_size"]
    # (see src/device_clone/pcileech_context.py:2323). Fall back to top-level for
    # legacy callers that pre-populate it directly.
    pcileech_config = template_context.get("pcileech_config") or {}
    max_payload_size = _coerce_int(
        pcileech_config.get("max_payload_size")
    ) or _coerce_int(template_context.get("max_payload_size"))
    # The producer writes the PCIe generation number (1..5) at top level — see
    # src/pci_capability/processor.py:452 (LinkCap bits[3:0]) and
    # src/device_clone/pcileech_context.py:912-918 (sysfs fallback maps
    # 2.5/5.0/8.0/16.0/32.0 GT/s to codes 1..5). Pass it as ``link_speed`` so
    # the emitter converts via _LINK_SPEED_ENCODING — passing it as
    # ``link_speed_code`` would reject Gen3 (3) and silently mis-emit Gen4 (4).
    link_speed = _coerce_int(template_context.get("pcie_max_link_speed"))
    link_width = _coerce_int(template_context.get("pcie_max_link_width"))
    aer_enabled = _coerce_bool(device_config.get("supports_aer"))
    ari_forwarding_supported = _coerce_bool(device_config.get("ari_capable"))

    cpl_ranges = device_config.get("cpl_timeout_ranges")
    if not isinstance(cpl_ranges, str) or not cpl_ranges:
        cpl_ranges = None
    # Preserve unsupported values so the emitter refuses the build. Dropping
    # them here would silently retain an unrelated IP default.
    cpl_disable = _coerce_bool(device_config.get("cpl_timeout_disable_sup"))

    dsn_value = _coerce_int(template_context.get("device_serial_number_int"))

    (
        bar_aperture_size,
        bar_is_memory,
        bar_is_64bit,
        bar_prefetchable,
        bar_index,
    ) = _served_bar_from_context(template_context)
    served_bars = served_bars_from_config(template_context.get("bar_config")) or ()

    msix_enabled = msix_table_size = msix_table_bir = None
    msix_table_offset = msix_pba_bir = msix_pba_offset = None
    reason = None
    plan = _msix_plan(result or {}, template_context)
    if plan.present:
        msix_enabled = False
        reason = plan.reason
        layout = plan.layout
        if layout is not None:
            aperture_matches = (
                any(
                    bar.index == layout.served_bar.index
                    and bar.size == layout.served_bar.size
                    for bar in served_bars
                )
                if served_bars
                else bar_index == layout.served_bar.index
                and bar_aperture_size == layout.served_bar.size
            )
            if not aperture_matches:
                # The generated RTL serves this layout; refuse rather than
                # advertise a capability at a different BAR or size.
                reason = "the MSI-X BAR disagrees with the IP aperture"
            else:
                msix_enabled = True
                msix_table_size = layout.vectors
                msix_table_bir = layout.capability.table_bir
                msix_table_offset = layout.table_start
                msix_pba_bir = layout.capability.pba_bir
                msix_pba_offset = layout.pba_start
    if reason:
        log_warning_safe(
            logger,
            safe_format(
                "MSI-X capability is not advertised because {reason}", reason=reason
            ),
            prefix="MSIX",
        )

    return DonorPCIeIPConfig(
        class_code=class_code,
        max_payload_size=max_payload_size,
        link_speed=link_speed,
        link_width=link_width,
        msix_enabled=msix_enabled,
        msix_table_size=msix_table_size,
        msix_table_bir=msix_table_bir,
        msix_table_offset=msix_table_offset,
        msix_pba_bir=msix_pba_bir,
        msix_pba_offset=msix_pba_offset,
        aer_enabled=aer_enabled,
        ari_forwarding_supported=ari_forwarding_supported,
        cpl_timeout_ranges=cpl_ranges,
        cpl_timeout_disable_supported=cpl_disable,
        extended_tag_supported=_coerce_bool(
            template_context.get("pcie_extended_tag_supported")
        ),
        dsn_value=dsn_value,
        bar_aperture_size=bar_aperture_size,
        bar_is_memory=bar_is_memory,
        bar_is_64bit=bar_is_64bit,
        bar_prefetchable=bar_prefetchable,
        bar_index=bar_index,
        served_bars=served_bars,
    )


# Emitted by sv_overlay_generator when the MSI-X subsystem is generated; its
# presence in a build's systemverilog_modules proves the controller RTL that
# implements the plan was produced in THIS build.
_MSIX_RTL_MARKER = "pcileech_msix_bar_router.sv"


def _msix_rtl_emitted(result: dict) -> bool:
    modules = (result or {}).get("systemverilog_modules") or {}
    return _MSIX_RTL_MARKER in modules


def _msix_plan(result: dict, template_context: dict) -> MsixSubsystemPlan:
    """The stored generation decision, or a refusal when there is none."""
    stored = template_context.get("msix_subsystem")
    if stored is not None:
        try:
            plan = MsixSubsystemPlan.from_context(template_context)
        except (MsixLayoutError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return plan_msix_subsystem(
                result, board_error="the stored MSI-X decision is malformed"
            )
        if plan.generated and not _msix_rtl_emitted(result):
            # A stored generated decision must only advertise MSI-X when this
            # build actually emitted the controller RTL. The host-context path
            # reuses the static board controller with systemverilog_modules == {},
            # so honoring a saved plan there would advertise a table that the
            # firmware does not implement.
            return MsixSubsystemPlan(
                present=True,
                reason="the MSI-X controller RTL was not generated for this build",
            )
        return plan
    return plan_msix_subsystem(
        result, board_error="the MSI-X subsystem is not generated"
    )


def _attr_or_key(obj, name, default=None):
    """Read ``name`` from an object attribute or a mapping key (defensive)."""
    if obj is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return obj.get(name, default)
    return getattr(obj, name, default)


def _served_bar_from_context(template_context: dict):
    """Extract the served BAR's (size, is_memory, is_64bit, prefetchable).

    Anchors on the SAME entry the BAR controller serves —
    ``bars[primary_bar|default(0)]`` (see pcileech_tlps128_bar_controller.sv.j2)
    — so the emitted IP aperture is guaranteed to match the controller's
    ``BAR_SIZE``. Returns all-None when the served BAR can't be read, leaving
    the Xilinx IP default in place rather than emitting a bad aperture.
    """
    none5 = (None, None, None, None, None)
    bar_config = template_context.get("bar_config") or {}
    descriptors = served_bars_from_config(bar_config)
    if descriptors is not None:
        register = next(
            bar for bar in descriptors if bar.role in ("registers", "registers+msix")
        )
        return (
            register.size,
            register.is_memory,
            register.is_64bit,
            register.prefetchable,
            register.index,
        )
    bars = _attr_or_key(bar_config, "bars") or []
    # ``primary_bar`` is the list position of the served BAR within ``bars``;
    # the controller indexes the same way (bars[primary_bar]).
    index = _coerce_int(_attr_or_key(bar_config, "primary_bar", 0)) or 0
    if index >= len(bars):
        return none5

    served = bars[index]
    size = _coerce_int(_attr_or_key(served, "size"))
    if not size:
        return none5

    is_io = bool(_attr_or_key(served, "is_io", False))
    is_memory = _attr_or_key(served, "is_memory", None)
    if is_memory is None:
        is_memory = not is_io
    is_memory = bool(is_memory)

    # Defensive: don't propagate an aperture the emitter would reject — leave
    # the Xilinx IP default in place instead of failing the build.
    if _bar_aperture_error(size, is_memory) is not None:
        return none5

    # Served donor PCI index N: prefer the explicit bar_config key, else the
    # served BAR's own .index. This is the slot the controller gates on and the
    # IP enables (CONFIG.Bar{N}_*).
    served_index = _coerce_int(_attr_or_key(bar_config, "served_bar_index", None))
    if served_index is None:
        served_index = _coerce_int(_attr_or_key(served, "index", 0)) or 0

    return (
        size,
        is_memory,
        bool(_attr_or_key(served, "is_64bit", False)),
        bool(_attr_or_key(served, "prefetchable", False)),
        served_index,
    )

```

`src/vivado_handling/pcileech_build_integration.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
PCILeech Build Integration Module

Stage 3 (Vivado project construction) consumes the artifact set that Stage 2
finalized under ``output/src``, ``output/ip`` and ``output/constraints``, as
recorded in ``output/stage2_artifacts.json``. It never rediscovers or copies
stock board RTL, IP or constraints: a missing or inconsistent artifact is an
error, not permission to substitute the unmodified board design.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Mapping, Optional, Tuple

from ..file_management.board_discovery import BoardDiscovery, get_board_config
from ..file_management.repo_manager import RepoManager
from ..log_config import get_logger
from ..string_utils import (
    log_debug_safe,
    log_error_safe,
    log_info_safe,
    log_warning_safe,
    safe_format,
)
from ..utils.file_manifest import FileManifestTracker
from .build_evidence import build_quality_tcl, write_build_manifest
from .ip_build_contract import (
    CAPTURE_PCIE_CONTRACT_TCL,
    RESTORE_PCIE_CONTRACT_TCL,
    VERIFY_PCIE_CONTRACT_TCL,
)
from .memory_ip_contract import (
    CAPTURE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL,
    RESTORE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL,
)
from .requester_plan import PLAN_FILES, PLAN_TCL, REQUESTER_SOURCE

logger = get_logger(__name__)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 2 -> Stage 3 artifact contract
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME = "stage2_artifacts.json"
STAGE2_MANIFEST_VERSION = 2
DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME = "pcileech_donor_ip_overrides.tcl"
REQUIRED_HEADER = "pcileech_header.svh"
HDL_SUFFIXES = (".sv", ".svh", ".v")
CFGSPACE_COE = "pcileech_cfgspace.coe"
WRITEMASK_COE = "pcileech_cfgspace_writemask.coe"
# Initialization memories whose content is donor data. A board IP that
# references one of these must receive this run's generated copy; the stock
# file of the same name is never acceptable.
GENERATED_MEMORY_FILES = (CFGSPACE_COE, WRITEMASK_COE)
# Board implementation hooks Stage 2 may carry from the board directory, and
# the impl_1 step property each one is attached to. Only these names are
# accepted; a board without them builds with the stock implementation steps.
IMPL_HOOKS_DIR = "impl_hooks"
# A board's endpoint-scoped CDC disposition checker (board-relative source),
# staged as cdc_check/check_cdc.tcl and run on the routed checkpoint.
CDC_CHECK_DIR = "cdc_check"
CDC_CHECK_NAME = "check_cdc.tcl"
CDC_CHECK_BOARD_PATH = "sim/cdc/check_cdc.tcl"
# Content pins: a checker replaces the blanket CDC gate only when it is the
# reviewed one for that board (sim/cdc/README.md disposition). An edited or
# unknown checker is not staged, so the stricter blanket gate applies.
QUALIFIED_CDC_CHECKER_SHA256 = {
    "pcileech_100t484_x1": (
        "ec6612fbe550fee2dc5bbb1947b9b2d8adc4a2afd81031abec9fba187ad104c2"
    ),
}
IMPL_HOOK_STEPS = {
    "place_design_post.tcl": "STEPS.PLACE_DESIGN.TCL.POST",
}

_COE_REF_RE = re.compile(r"([A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+\.coe)\b")


class BuildArtifactError(RuntimeError):
    """Stage 2 artifacts are missing, incomplete or inconsistent."""


# Legacy script default, used only when no job count was selected.
_DEFAULT_RUN_JOBS_TCL = """set RUN_JOBS 8
if {[info exists ::env(VIVADO_RUN_JOBS)] && $::env(VIVADO_RUN_JOBS) > 0} {
    set RUN_JOBS $::env(VIVADO_RUN_JOBS)
}"""


def validate_vivado_jobs(value: Any) -> int:
    """Return ``value`` as a Vivado job count, rejecting non-positive counts."""
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Vivado job count must be a positive integer, got {value!r}")
    return value


def run_jobs_tcl(vivado_jobs: Optional[int]) -> str:
    """Tcl that sets RUN_JOBS; a selected count is fixed in the script."""
    if vivado_jobs is None:
        return _DEFAULT_RUN_JOBS_TCL
    return f"set RUN_JOBS {validate_vivado_jobs(vivado_jobs)}"


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    """Return the hex SHA-256 of a file's bytes."""
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(65536), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def xci_memory_references(xci_path: Path) -> List[str]:
    """Return the COE basenames an XCI (JSON or XML) initializes from."""
    text = Path(xci_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    names = {Path(m.replace("\\", "/")).name for m in _COE_REF_RE.findall(text)}
    return sorted(names)


def _plain_name(name: Any, field: str) -> str:
    """Reject manifest entries that are not bare file names."""
    if (
        not isinstance(name, str)
        or not name
        or name in (".", "..")
        or "/" in name
        or "\\" in name
    ):
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "Invalid {field} entry in {manifest}: {name!r}",
                field=field,
                manifest=STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME,
                name=name,
            )
        )
    return name


def stage_generated_memories(
    output_dir: Path, memories: Mapping[str, str]
) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """Write this run's generated memories to ``src/`` and overlay ``ip/``.

    Must run after Stage 2 has staged the board IP (so the overlay replaces
    the stock COE of the same name) and before the manifest is written.
    Returns ``{name: sha256}`` of the content now present in both places.
    """
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    if CFGSPACE_COE not in memories or not memories[CFGSPACE_COE].strip():
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "Generation produced no {name}; refusing to build with the "
                "stock configuration-space memory",
                name=CFGSPACE_COE,
            )
        )
    src_dir = output_dir / "src"
    ip_dir = output_dir / "ip"
    if not ip_dir.is_dir() or not any(ip_dir.glob("*.xci")):
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "No staged IP definitions under {path}; Stage 2 IP staging "
                "did not run or failed",
                path=str(ip_dir),
            )
        )
    src_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    hashes: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for name, content in memories.items():
        _plain_name(name, "generated memory")
        if not content or not content.strip():
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Generated memory {name} is empty", name=name)
            )
        data = content.encode("utf-8")
        expected = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        for dest in (src_dir / name, ip_dir / name):
            try:
                dest.write_bytes(data)
            except OSError as e:
                raise BuildArtifactError(
                    safe_format(
                        "Failed to write generated memory {path}: {err}",
                        path=str(dest),
                        err=e,
                    )
                ) from e
            if sha256_file(dest) != expected:
                raise BuildArtifactError(
                    safe_format("Verification failed for {path}", path=str(dest))
                )
        hashes[name] = expected
    return hashes


def write_stage2_manifest(
    output_dir: Path,
    *,
    board: str,
    sources: Iterable[str],
    constraints: Iterable[str],
    generated_memories: Mapping[str, str],
    ip_definitions: Iterable[str],
    impl_hooks: Iterable[str] = (),
    cdc_check: bool = False,
) -> Path:
    """Record the authoritative Stage 2 artifact set, then validate it.

    Only files listed here reach the Vivado project; anything else left in
    the output tree (for example from an earlier run) is excluded.
    ``impl_hooks`` names board implementation hooks staged in
    ``output_dir/impl_hooks`` (see ``IMPL_HOOK_STEPS``).
    """
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    ip_dir = output_dir / "ip"
    xci = sorted({_plain_name(name, "IP definition") for name in ip_definitions})
    if not xci or any(not name.endswith(".xci") for name in xci):
        raise BuildArtifactError("Generation did not record a valid IP definition set")
    memories = set()
    for name in xci:
        memories.update(xci_memory_references(ip_dir / name))
    override = output_dir / DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME
    hooks = sorted({_plain_name(name, "implementation hook") for name in impl_hooks})
    for name in hooks:
        if name not in IMPL_HOOK_STEPS:
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Unknown implementation hook {name}", name=name)
            )
    manifest: dict[str, Any] = {
        "version": STAGE2_MANIFEST_VERSION,
        "board": board,
        "sources": sorted(set(sources)),
        "ip": {"xci": xci, "memories": sorted(memories)},
        "constraints": sorted(set(constraints)),
        "generated_memories": dict(sorted(generated_memories.items())),
        "donor_ip_override": {
            "name": DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME,
            "sha256": sha256_file(override) if override.is_file() else None,
        },
        "impl_hooks": hooks,
        "cdc_check": CDC_CHECK_NAME if cdc_check else None,
    }
    manifest["input_hashes"] = {}
    if REQUESTER_SOURCE in manifest["sources"]:
        manifest["requester_plan"] = {}
        for name in PLAN_FILES:
            artifact = output_dir / name
            if not artifact.is_file() or not artifact.stat().st_size:
                raise BuildArtifactError(f"Missing requester plan input: {artifact}")
            manifest["requester_plan"][name] = sha256_file(artifact)
    for directory, names in (
        ("src", manifest["sources"]),
        ("ip", xci),
        ("constraints", manifest["constraints"]),
        (IMPL_HOOKS_DIR, hooks),
        (CDC_CHECK_DIR, [CDC_CHECK_NAME] if cdc_check else []),
    ):
        for name in names:
            _plain_name(name, directory)
            artifact = output_dir / directory / name
            if not artifact.is_file():
                raise BuildArtifactError(f"Missing generated input: {artifact}")
            manifest["input_hashes"][f"{directory}/{name}"] = sha256_file(artifact)
    path = output_dir / STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    validate_stage2_artifacts(output_dir, board=board)
    return path


def validate_stage2_artifacts(
    output_dir: Path, board: Optional[str] = None
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Load the Stage 2 manifest and verify every artifact it names.

    Raises BuildArtifactError on the first missing, empty or mismatched
    input. Never consults the board repository.
    """
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    path = output_dir / STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME
    if not path.is_file():
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "Stage 2 artifact manifest not found at {path}. Run firmware "
                "generation for this board into this output directory first; "
                "Stage 3 does not fall back to stock board sources.",
                path=str(path),
            )
        )
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format("Unreadable {path}: {err}", path=str(path), err=e)
        ) from e
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or (
        manifest.get("version") != STAGE2_MANIFEST_VERSION
    ):
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format("Unsupported manifest format in {path}", path=str(path))
        )
    if board is not None and manifest.get("board") != board:
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "Stage 2 artifacts were generated for board {have}, not {want}",
                have=manifest.get("board"),
                want=board,
            )
        )

    def _names(value: Any, field: str) -> List[str]:
        if not isinstance(value, list):
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Manifest field {field} must be a list", field=field)
            )
        return [_plain_name(v, field) for v in value]

    def _require(path_: Path, what: str) -> None:
        if not path_.is_file():
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Missing {what}: {path}", what=what, path=str(path_))
            )
        if path_.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Empty {what}: {path}", what=what, path=str(path_))
            )

    src_dir = output_dir / "src"
    sources = _names(manifest.get("sources"), "sources")
    if REQUIRED_HEADER not in sources:
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "Generated source set lacks {hdr}; Stage 2 board source "
                "assembly is incomplete",
                hdr=REQUIRED_HEADER,
            )
        )
    if not any(n.endswith(".sv") for n in sources):
        raise BuildArtifactError("Generated source set contains no .sv files")
    for name in sources:
        if not name.endswith(HDL_SUFFIXES):
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Non-HDL entry in sources: {name}", name=name)
            )
        _require(src_dir / name, "generated source")

    ip_dir = output_dir / "ip"
    ip = manifest.get("ip")
    if not isinstance(ip, dict):
        raise BuildArtifactError("Manifest field ip must be an object")
    xci = _names(ip.get("xci"), "ip.xci")
    if not xci:
        raise BuildArtifactError("Stage 2 staged no IP definitions (.xci)")
    referenced = set()
    for name in xci:
        _require(ip_dir / name, "staged IP definition")
        referenced.update(xci_memory_references(ip_dir / name))
    listed = set(_names(ip.get("memories"), "ip.memories"))
    if referenced != listed:
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "Staged IP memory references changed since Stage 2: "
                "manifest={listed} actual={actual}",
                listed=sorted(listed),
                actual=sorted(referenced),
            )
        )
    for name in sorted(referenced):
        _require(ip_dir / name, "IP initialization memory")

    generated = manifest.get("generated_memories")
    if not isinstance(generated, dict):
        raise BuildArtifactError("Manifest field generated_memories must be an object")
    if CFGSPACE_COE not in generated:
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format("No generated {name} recorded", name=CFGSPACE_COE)
        )
    for name in GENERATED_MEMORY_FILES:
        if name in referenced and name not in generated:
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format(
                    "Staged IP initializes from {name} but Stage 2 generated "
                    "none; the stock board memory would be built",
                    name=name,
                )
            )
    for name, digest in generated.items():
        _plain_name(name, "generated_memories")
        for where in (src_dir / name, ip_dir / name):
            _require(where, "generated memory")
            if sha256_file(where) != digest:
                raise BuildArtifactError(
                    safe_format(
                        "{path} does not match the generated {name} "
                        "(stale or stock content)",
                        path=str(where),
                        name=name,
                    )
                )

    constraints = _names(manifest.get("constraints"), "constraints")
    if not constraints:
        raise BuildArtifactError("Stage 2 staged no constraint files")
    for name in constraints:
        if not name.endswith(".xdc"):
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Non-XDC entry in constraints: {name}", name=name)
            )
        _require(output_dir / "constraints" / name, "staged constraint file")

    override = manifest.get("donor_ip_override") or {}
    override_path = output_dir / DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME
    if override.get("name") != DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME or not override.get("sha256"):
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            "Stage 2 produced no donor PCIe IP override; the hard IP would "
            "keep stock identity"
        )
    _require(override_path, "donor PCIe IP override")
    if sha256_file(override_path) != override["sha256"]:
        raise BuildArtifactError(
            safe_format(
                "{path} changed since Stage 2 finalized it",
                path=str(override_path),
            )
        )
    hooks = _names(manifest.get("impl_hooks"), "impl_hooks")
    for name in hooks:
        if name not in IMPL_HOOK_STEPS:
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format("Unknown implementation hook {name}", name=name)
            )
        _require(output_dir / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR / name, "implementation hook")
    expected_paths = {
        *(f"src/{name}" for name in sources),
        *(f"ip/{name}" for name in xci),
        *(f"constraints/{name}" for name in constraints),
        *(f"{IMPL_HOOKS_DIR}/{name}" for name in hooks),
    }
    cdc_check = manifest.get("cdc_check")
    if cdc_check is not None:
        if cdc_check != CDC_CHECK_NAME:
            raise BuildArtifactError("Unknown board CDC checker")
        _require(output_dir / CDC_CHECK_DIR / CDC_CHECK_NAME, "board CDC checker")
        expected_paths.add(f"{CDC_CHECK_DIR}/{CDC_CHECK_NAME}")
    input_hashes = manifest.get("input_hashes", {})
    if REQUESTER_SOURCE in sources:
        requester = manifest.get("requester_plan")
        if not isinstance(requester, dict) or set(requester) != set(PLAN_FILES):
            raise BuildArtifactError("Incomplete requester plan inventory")
        for name, digest in requester.items():
            _require(output_dir / name, "requester plan input")
            if sha256_file(output_dir / name) != digest:
                raise BuildArtifactError(f"Changed requester plan input: {name}")
    elif manifest.get("requester_plan"):
        raise BuildArtifactError("Requester plan recorded without requester RTL")
    if set(input_hashes) != expected_paths:
        raise BuildArtifactError("Stage 2 input hash inventory is incomplete")
    for name, digest in input_hashes.items():
        if sha256_file(output_dir / name) != digest:
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                f"Stage 2 input changed after finalization: {name}"
            )
    return manifest


class PCILeechBuildIntegration:
    """Integrates pcileech-fpga repository with the build process."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        output_dir: Path,
        repo_root: Optional[Path] = None,
        manifest_tracker=None,
        logger=None,
    ):
        """
        Initialize the build integration.

        Args:
            output_dir: Output directory for build artifacts
            repo_root: Optional repository root path
            manifest_tracker: Optional file manifest tracker
            logger: Optional logger
        """
        self.output_dir = Path(output_dir)
        self.repo_root = repo_root or RepoManager.ensure_repo()
        self.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.file_manifest = manifest_tracker
        self.logger = logger

        # Cache discovered boards
        self._boards_cache: Optional[Dict[str, Dict]] = None
        self.prefix = "BUILD"

    def get_available_boards(self) -> Dict[str, Dict]:
        """
        Get all available boards from the repository.

        Returns:
            Dictionary mapping board names to configurations
        """
        if self._boards_cache is None:
            self._boards_cache = BoardDiscovery.discover_boards(self.repo_root)
        return self._boards_cache

    def prepare_build_environment(self, board_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Prepare the build environment for a specific board.

        Args:
            board_name: Name of the board to build for

        Returns:
            Dictionary containing build configuration and paths

        Raises:
            ValueError: If board is not found
        """
        # Get board configuration
        boards = self.get_available_boards()
        if board_name not in boards:
            raise ValueError(
                safe_format(
                    "Board '{board_name}' not found. Available: {available_boards}",
                    board_name=board_name,
                    available_boards=", ".join(boards.keys()),
                )
            )

        board_config = boards[board_name]
        log_info_safe(
            logger,
            "Preparing build environment for {board_name}",
            board_name=board_name,
            prefix=self.prefix,
        )

        # Stage 3 consumes only what Stage 2 finalized and recorded. Validate
        # the whole set before touching the board directory so an incomplete
        # generation can never be "completed" from stock board files.
        manifest = self._load_stage2_manifest(board_name)

        # Create board-specific output directory
        board_output_dir = self.output_dir / board_name
        board_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        xdc_files = self._copy_xdc_files(board_name, board_output_dir / "constraints")
        src_files = self._copy_source_files(board_name, board_output_dir)
        ip_files = self._copy_ip_files(board_name, board_output_dir / "ip")

        # Patch XCI speed grade to match board's target FPGA part.
        # Some upstream XCI files are generated for a different speed grade
        # than the board targets, causing Vivado to lock the IP cores.
        fpga_part = board_config.get("fpga_part", "")
        if fpga_part and (board_output_dir / "ip").is_dir():
            from .ip_lock_resolver import patch_xci_speed_grade

            patch_xci_speed_grade(
                board_output_dir,
                fpga_part,
                logger=logger,
                prefix=self.prefix,
            )

        # Fail fast if no IP definition files were staged. These are required
        # for Vivado IP import/regeneration.
        if not ip_files:
            log_error_safe(
                logger,
                safe_format(
                    "Build aborted: no staged IP definition files for board "
                    "{board}. Re-run firmware generation for this board.",
                    board=board_name,
                ),
                prefix=self.prefix,
            )
            raise SystemExit(2)

        # The memories Vivado imports must still be this run's generated data
        # after every Stage 3 step that touched the board IP directory.
        self._verify_staged_memories(manifest, board_output_dir / "ip")

        return {
            "board_name": board_name,
            "board_config": board_config,
            "output_dir": board_output_dir,
            # Board templates and build scripts are not staged. build_all.tcl
            # builds the project from the artifacts above.
            "templates": {},
            "xdc_files": xdc_files,
            "src_files": src_files,
            "ip_files": ip_files,
            "build_scripts": {},
            "stage2_manifest": manifest,
        }

    def _load_stage2_manifest(self, board_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate and cache the Stage 2 manifest for ``board_name``."""
        cached = getattr(self, "_stage2_manifest", None)
        if cached is not None and cached.get("board") == board_name:
            return cached
        manifest = validate_stage2_artifacts(self.output_dir, board=board_name)
        self._stage2_manifest = manifest
        return manifest

    def _stage_artifacts(
        self, source_dir: Path, names: Iterable[str], dest_dir: Path, kind: str
    ) -> List[Path]:
        """Copy named Stage 2 artifacts into the board build tree.

        Every failure raises: a partially staged directory would silently
        build a different design. A destination that already *is* the source
        (an in-place layout) is used as-is rather than copied onto itself.
        """
        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        staged: List[Path] = []
        for name in names:
            src = source_dir / name
            dest = dest_dir / name
            if not src.is_file():
                raise BuildArtifactError(
                    safe_format(
                        "Missing {kind} artifact {path}", kind=kind, path=str(src)
                    )
                )
            try:
                same = dest.exists() and os.path.samefile(src, dest)
            except OSError:
                same = False
            if not same:
                if self.file_manifest and not self.file_manifest.add_copy_operation(
                    src, dest
                ):
                    raise BuildArtifactError(
                        safe_format(
                            "Two {kind} artifacts map to {dest}",
                            kind=kind,
                            dest=str(dest),
                        )
                    )
                try:
                    shutil.copy2(src, dest)
                except OSError as e:
                    raise BuildArtifactError(
                        safe_format(
                            "Failed to stage {kind} artifact {src} -> {dest}: {err}",
                            kind=kind,
                            src=str(src),
                            dest=str(dest),
                            err=e,
                        )
                    ) from e
            # Compare the staged bytes with what Stage 2 recorded, not with the
            # source as it is now: the manifest check may predate this copy.
            recorded = (getattr(self, "_stage2_manifest", None) or {}).get(
                "input_hashes", {}
            )
            key = f"{source_dir.name}/{name}"
            if key in recorded and sha256_file(dest) != recorded[key]:
                raise BuildArtifactError(
                    safe_format(
                        "Stage 2 input changed after finalization: {name}",
                        name=key,
                    )
                )
            staged.append(dest)
            log_debug_safe(
                logger,
                safe_format("Staged {kind}: {name}", kind=kind, name=name),
                prefix=self.prefix,
            )
        log_info_safe(
            logger,
            safe_format(
                "Staged {count} {kind} artifact(s) from {src}",
                count=len(staged),
                kind=kind,
                src=str(source_dir),
            ),
            prefix=self.prefix,
        )
        return staged

    def _verify_staged_memories(self, manifest: Dict[str, Any], ip_dir: Path) -> None:
        """Require the board IP directory to hold the generated memories."""
        for name, digest in manifest["generated_memories"].items():
            path = ip_dir / name
            if not path.is_file() or sha256_file(path) != digest:
                raise BuildArtifactError(
                    safe_format(
                        "Staged IP memory {path} is not the generated {name}",
                        path=str(path),
                        name=name,
                    )
                )

    def _copy_xdc_files(self, board_name: str, output_dir: Path) -> List[Path]:
        """Stage the constraint files Stage 2 recorded in output/constraints."""
        manifest = self._load_stage2_manifest(board_name)
        return self._stage_artifacts(
            self.output_dir / "constraints",
            manifest["constraints"],
            output_dir,
            "constraint",
        )

    def _copy_source_files(self, board_name: str, output_dir: Path) -> List[Path]:
        """Stage the generated HDL source set into ``output_dir/src``.

        output/src is the complete, authoritative design: board support
        assembled by Stage 2 plus the generated overlays. There is no
        repository fallback; a missing header or empty set means generation
        was incomplete and manifest validation reports it. Files are placed
        flat in ``src/`` so build scripts see predictable include paths.
        """
        manifest = self._load_stage2_manifest(board_name)
        return self._stage_artifacts(
            self.output_dir / "src", manifest["sources"], output_dir / "src", "source"
        )

    def _copy_ip_files(self, board_name: str, output_dir: Path) -> List[Path]:
        """Stage IP definitions and initialization memories from output/ip.

        Stage 2 staged the board IP and overlaid this run's generated COEs.
        Stock board IP is never re-fetched here: that would silently replace
        donor configuration space and write masks with stock data.
        """
        manifest = self._load_stage2_manifest(board_name)
        ip = manifest["ip"]
        names = list(ip["xci"]) + list(ip["memories"])
        staged = self._stage_artifacts(self.output_dir / "ip", names, output_dir, "IP")
        self._verify_staged_memories(manifest, output_dir)
        return staged

    def create_unified_build_script(
        self,
        board_name: str,
        device_config: Optional[Dict] = None,
        vivado_jobs: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """
        Create a unified build script that incorporates all necessary steps.

        Args:
            board_name: Name of the board
            device_config: Optional device-specific configuration (unused, kept for backwards compatibility)
            vivado_jobs: Selected launch_runs job count; None keeps the
                legacy default of 8 overridable by VIVADO_RUN_JOBS

        Returns:
            Path to the unified build script
        """
        jobs_tcl = run_jobs_tcl(vivado_jobs)
        # A local preflight can fail before Tcl has a chance to invalidate the
        # previous live readback. Archive it before validating this run's inputs.
        board_output = self.output_dir / board_name
        if not board_output.resolve().is_relative_to(self.output_dir.resolve()):
            raise BuildArtifactError("Board output escapes the output directory")
        resolved = board_output / "requester_plan_resolved.json"
        if resolved.exists() or resolved.is_symlink():
            resolved.rename(
                board_output / f"previous-requester-plan-{uuid.uuid4().hex}.json"
            )
        # Prepare build environment
        build_env = self.prepare_build_environment(board_name)
        # A rerun must not leave a prior successful image beside new inputs.
        # Preserve it as an explicitly historical result rather than deleting it.
        published = build_env["output_dir"] / "output"
        if published.exists():
            published.rename(published.with_name(f"previous-output-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"))

        # Create unified script
        script_path = build_env["output_dir"] / "build_all.tcl"

        board_config = build_env.get("board_config", {})
        if "fpga_part" not in board_config or not board_config["fpga_part"]:
            log_error_safe(
                logger,
                safe_format(
                    "Missing required 'fpga_part' for board '{board_name}' in unified build script generation.",
                    board_name=board_name,
                ),
                prefix=self.prefix,
            )
            raise ValueError(
                safe_format(
                    "Cannot create unified build script: missing required 'fpga_part' for board '{board_name}'.",
                    board_name=board_name,
                )
            )
        fpga_part = board_config["fpga_part"]
        project_name = safe_format("pcileech_{board_name}", board_name=board_name)

        script_content = safe_format(
            """
# PCILeech Unified Build Script for {board_name}
# Generated by PCILeechBuildIntegration

puts "Starting PCILeech build for board: {board_name}"
puts "FPGA Part: {fpga_part}"

# Change to board-specific directory for relative path resolution
cd [file dirname [info script]]
puts "Working directory: [pwd]"

# Set project parameters
set PROJECT_NAME "{project_name}"
set PROJECT_DIR "./vivado_project"
set OUTPUT_DIR "./output"
set FPGA_PART "{fpga_part}"

# Create project directory
file mkdir $PROJECT_DIR
file mkdir $OUTPUT_DIR

# Create the project from the Stage 2 artifact set only. Stock board project
# scripts add stock sources and IP, so they are never sourced here.
create_project $PROJECT_NAME $PROJECT_DIR -part $FPGA_PART -force

# Add source files
puts "Adding source files..."
""",
            board_name=board_name,
            fpga_part=fpga_part,
            project_name=project_name,
        )

        # Add source files (deduplicate exact paths to avoid true duplicates)
        script_content += "\n# Add source files\n"
        script_content += 'puts "Adding source files..."\n'

        # Track added files to avoid duplicates
        added_files = set()
        board_output_dir = build_env["output_dir"]

        for src_file in build_env["src_files"]:
            src_path = Path(src_file)
            # Use relative path from board directory
            try:
                rel_path = src_path.relative_to(board_output_dir)
            except ValueError:
                # If file is not under board_output_dir, use the filename and assume it's in src/
                rel_path = Path("src") / src_path.name

            rel_path_str = str(rel_path)
            # Skip if this file has already been added
            if rel_path_str in added_files:
                continue
            added_files.add(rel_path_str)

            script_content += f'add_files -norecurse "{rel_path}"\n'

        # Import exactly the staged IP definitions (not a directory glob, which
        # would also pick up stale XCIs). import_files copies each XCI with its
        # adjacent initialization memories into the project. Failure to add a
        # required IP is fatal: a missing BRAM/PCIe core is not a warning.
        xci_rel = []
        for ip_file in build_env["ip_files"]:
            ip_path = Path(ip_file)
            if ip_path.suffix != ".xci":
                continue
            try:
                xci_rel.append(str(ip_path.relative_to(board_output_dir)))
            except ValueError:
                xci_rel.append(str(Path("ip") / ip_path.name))
        script_content += "\n# Add staged IP cores (import to avoid locked IP issues)\n"
        script_content += 'puts "Adding IP cores..."\n'
        script_content += "set ip_files [list"
        for rel in xci_rel:
            script_content += f' [file normalize "{rel}"]'
        script_content += "]\n"
        script_content += (
            "if {[llength $ip_files] == 0} {\n"
            '    error "No staged IP definitions to import"\n'
            "}\n"
            "set fs [get_filesets sources_1]\n"
            "foreach ip_file $ip_files {\n"
            "    set ip_name [file rootname [file tail $ip_file]]\n"
            '    puts "Importing IP: $ip_name"\n'
            "    if {![file exists $ip_file]} {\n"
            '        error "Staged IP definition missing: $ip_file"\n'
            "    }\n"
            "    if {[catch {import_files -norecurse -fileset $fs $ip_file} import_err]} {\n"
            '        error "Failed to import IP $ip_name without modifying staged inputs: $import_err"\n'
            "    }\n"
            "}\n"
            "update_ip_catalog -rebuild -scan_changes\n"
        )

        memories = build_env["stage2_manifest"]["ip"]["memories"]
        script_content += "set staged_memory_names [list " + " ".join(memories) + "]\n"
        generated_memories = build_env["stage2_manifest"]["generated_memories"]
        script_content += (
            "set generated_memory_names [list "
            + " ".join(sorted(generated_memories))
            + "]\n"
        )
        script_content += CAPTURE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL
        script_content += CAPTURE_PCIE_CONTRACT_TCL
        link_speed = board_config.get("pcie_link_speed")
        if link_speed is not None:
            if link_speed not in ("2.5_GT/s", "5.0_GT/s"):
                raise BuildArtifactError("Unsupported board PCIe link speed")
            script_content += (
                f'puts "Applying explicit board link-speed limit: {link_speed}"\n'
                f"dict set board_pcie_contract CONFIG.Link_Speed {{{link_speed}}}\n"
            )
        script_content += RESTORE_PCIE_CONTRACT_TCL
        script_content += RESTORE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL

        # Ensure all .sv and .svh files are treated as SystemVerilog
        # CRITICAL: .svh files containing interface definitions (like IfAXIS128) must be
        # compiled as SystemVerilog, NOT as Verilog Header. Interfaces are design units
        # that need to be compiled, not just included as text.
        script_content += "\n# Set SystemVerilog file types\n"
        script_content += (
            "set sv_in_proj "
            "[get_files -of_objects [get_filesets sources_1] *.sv]\n"
            "if {[llength $sv_in_proj] > 0} {\n"
            '    puts "Setting SystemVerilog type for '
            '[llength $sv_in_proj] files"\n'
            "    set_property file_type SystemVerilog $sv_in_proj\n"
            "}\n"
            "# CRITICAL FIX: Set .svh files as SystemVerilog (not Verilog Header)\n"
            "# because pcileech_header.svh contains interface definitions (IfAXIS128, etc.)\n"
            "# which are design units that must be compiled, not just text-included.\n"
            "set svh_in_proj "
            "[get_files -of_objects [get_filesets sources_1] *.svh]\n"
            "if {[llength $svh_in_proj] > 0} {\n"
            '    puts "Setting SystemVerilog type for '
            '[llength $svh_in_proj] header files (contains interface definitions)"\n'
            "    set_property file_type SystemVerilog $svh_in_proj\n"
            "}\n"
        )

        # Set include directories for SystemVerilog header files
        script_content += "\n# Set include directories for SystemVerilog headers\n"
        script_content += (
            'puts "Setting include directories for SystemVerilog headers..."\n'
            'set src_dir [file normalize "./src"]\n'
            "if {[file exists $src_dir]} {\n"
            "    set_property include_dirs [list $src_dir] [current_fileset]\n"
            '    puts "Include directory set: $src_dir"\n'
            "} else {\n"
            '    puts "WARNING: src directory not found at $src_dir"\n'
            "}\n"
        )

        # Refresh compile order after file-type changes
        script_content += "update_compile_order -fileset sources_1\n"

        # Add constraints
        script_content += "\n# Add constraint files\n"
        script_content += 'puts "Adding constraint files..."\n'
        for xdc_file in build_env["xdc_files"]:
            xdc_path = Path(xdc_file)
            # Use relative path from board directory
            try:
                rel_path = xdc_path.relative_to(board_output_dir)
            except ValueError:
                rel_path = Path("constraints") / xdc_path.name

            cmd = f'add_files -fileset constrs_1 -norecurse "{rel_path}"\n'
            script_content += cmd

        # Apply the generated donor-ID / MSI-X override to the hard PCIe IP.
        # The generator writes pcileech_donor_ip_overrides.tcl next to the build
        # output; without this the imported stock pcie_7x_0.xci keeps Xilinx's
        # Vendor/Device IDs and advertises no MSI-X, so the donor identity never
        # reaches the hard IP. It is sourced after IP import and before the
        # pre-synthesis generate_target so the regeneration picks up the config.
        # The override is mandatory: without it the hard IP keeps stock
        # identity. Manifest validation already required it and pinned its
        # hash; stage it like every other artifact and source it unconditionally
        # so a missing file aborts Vivado instead of building stock identity.
        override_dest = self._stage_artifacts(
            self.output_dir,
            [DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME],
            board_output_dir,
            "donor IP override",
        )[0]
        manifest = build_env.get("stage2_manifest") or self._load_stage2_manifest(
            board_name
        )
        if sha256_file(override_dest) != manifest["donor_ip_override"]["sha256"]:
            raise BuildArtifactError(
                safe_format(
                    "Staged donor IP override {path} does not match Stage 2",
                    path=str(override_dest),
                )
            )
        script_content += (
            "\n# [PCILeechFWGenerator] Apply donor-ID / MSI-X override to"
            " the hard PCIe IP (required)\n"
            'puts "Applying PCILeechFWGenerator donor IP override..."\n'
            f'source "{DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME}"\n'
        )
```
