```py
        assert params.temp_max_c == 90.0

    def test_variance_parameters_validation(self):
        """Test VarianceParameters validation in post_init."""
        # This should not raise an exception
        params = VarianceParameters(device_class=DeviceClass.CONSUMER)
        # Validation happens in __post_init__
        assert params.clock_jitter_percent_min <= params.clock_jitter_percent_max


class TestVarianceModel:
    """Test VarianceModel dataclass."""

    def test_variance_model_creation(self):
        """Test creating a VarianceModel."""
        model = VarianceModel(
            device_id="test_device",
            device_class=DeviceClass.CONSUMER,
            base_frequency_mhz=100.0,
            clock_jitter_percent=0.1,
            register_timing_jitter_ns=0.5,
            power_noise_percent=2.0,
            temperature_drift_ppm_per_c=50.0,
            process_variation_percent=5.0,
            propagation_delay_ps=100.0,
            operating_temp_c=25.0,
            supply_voltage_v=3.3,
        )
        assert model.device_id == "test_device"
        assert model.device_class == DeviceClass.CONSUMER
        assert model.base_frequency_mhz == 100.0

    def test_variance_model_timing_adjustments(self):
        """Test that timing adjustments are calculated in post_init."""
        model = VarianceModel(
            device_id="test_device",
            device_class=DeviceClass.CONSUMER,
            base_frequency_mhz=100.0,
            clock_jitter_percent=0.1,
            register_timing_jitter_ns=0.5,
            power_noise_percent=2.0,
            temperature_drift_ppm_per_c=50.0,
            process_variation_percent=5.0,
            propagation_delay_ps=100.0,
            operating_temp_c=25.0,
            supply_voltage_v=3.3,
        )
        # Check that timing adjustments were calculated
        assert "base_period_ns" in model.timing_adjustments
        assert "jitter_ns" in model.timing_adjustments
        assert "combined_timing_factor" in model.timing_adjustments

    def test_variance_model_to_json(self):
        """Test serializing VarianceModel to JSON."""
        model = VarianceModel(
            device_id="test_device",
            device_class=DeviceClass.CONSUMER,
            base_frequency_mhz=100.0,
            clock_jitter_percent=0.1,
            register_timing_jitter_ns=0.5,
            power_noise_percent=2.0,
            temperature_drift_ppm_per_c=50.0,
            process_variation_percent=5.0,
            propagation_delay_ps=100.0,
            operating_temp_c=25.0,
            supply_voltage_v=3.3,
        )
        json_str = model.to_json()
        data = json.loads(json_str)
        assert data["device_id"] == "test_device"
        assert data["device_class"] == "consumer"
        assert data["base_frequency_mhz"] == 100.0

    def test_variance_model_from_json(self):
        """Test deserializing VarianceModel from JSON."""
        json_data = {
            "device_id": "test_device",
            "device_class": "consumer",
            "base_frequency_mhz": 100.0,
            "clock_jitter_percent": 0.1,
            "register_timing_jitter_ns": 0.5,
            "power_noise_percent": 2.0,
            "temperature_drift_ppm_per_c": 50.0,
            "process_variation_percent": 5.0,
            "propagation_delay_ps": 100.0,
            "operating_temp_c": 25.0,
            "supply_voltage_v": 3.3,
        }
        json_str = json.dumps(json_data)
        model = VarianceModel.from_json(json_str)
        assert model.device_id == "test_device"
        assert model.device_class == DeviceClass.CONSUMER
        assert model.base_frequency_mhz == 100.0
```

`tests/test_memory_ip_contract.py`:

```py
"""Memory initialization survives an IP upgrade, or the build aborts."""

import shutil
import subprocess

import pytest
from pcileechfwgenerator.vivado_handling.memory_ip_contract import (
    CAPTURE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL,
    RESTORE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL,
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("ignore_load", [False, True])
def test_memory_initialization_cannot_be_silently_disabled(tmp_path, ignore_load):
    tcl = shutil.which("tclsh")
    if not tcl:
        pytest.skip("Tcl interpreter required")
    (tmp_path / "ip").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "ip" / "generated.coe").write_text("memory_initialization_radix=16;\n")
    harness = r"""
set staged_memory_names {generated.coe}
set generated_memory_names {generated.coe}
set values [dict create CONFIG.Coe_File generated.coe CONFIG.Load_Init_File true NAME memory IP_FILE ip/memory.xci]
proc get_ips {args} {return memory}
proc list_property {ip} {return [dict keys $::values]}
proc get_property {key ip} {return [dict get $::values $key]}
proc set_property {flag settings ip} {
 dict for {k v} $settings {
  if {$::ignore_load && $k eq "CONFIG.Load_Init_File"} {continue}
  dict set ::values $k $v
 }
}
"""
    script = tmp_path / "check.tcl"
    script.write_text(
        f"set ignore_load {int(ignore_load)}\n"
        + harness
        + CAPTURE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL
        + "\ndict set values CONFIG.Load_Init_File false\n"
        + "dict set values CONFIG.Coe_File no_coe_file_loaded\n"
        + "if {[catch {\n"
        + RESTORE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL
        + "\n} why]} {puts stderr $why; exit 1}\n"
    )
    result = subprocess.run(
        [tcl, str(script)], cwd=tmp_path, capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    assert (result.returncode == 0) is (not ignore_load), result.stderr
    if ignore_load:
        assert "disabled initialization" in result.stderr


@pytest.mark.parametrize("binding", ["", "no_coe_file_loaded", "other.coe"])
def test_generated_memory_must_have_a_live_ip_binding(tmp_path, binding):
    tcl = shutil.which("tclsh")
    if not tcl:
        pytest.skip("Tcl interpreter required")
    (tmp_path / "ip").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "ip" / "other.coe").write_text("memory_initialization_radix=16;\n")
    script = tmp_path / "check.tcl"
    script.write_text(f"set binding {{{binding}}}\n" + r"""
set staged_memory_names {generated.coe other.coe}
set generated_memory_names {generated.coe}
proc get_ips {args} {return memory}
proc list_property {ip} {return {CONFIG.Coe_File NAME}}
proc get_property {key ip} {
    if {$key eq "NAME"} {return memory}
    return $::binding
}
""" + CAPTURE_MEMORY_CONTRACT_TCL)
    result = subprocess.run(
        [tcl, str(script)], cwd=tmp_path, capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    assert result.returncode != 0
    assert "Generated memory is not bound to an IP: generated.coe" in result.stderr
```

`tests/test_mmio_exercise.py`:

```py
"""Device exercises run inside the mmiotrace window (fake sysfs only)."""

import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect import exercise
from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect.exercise import (
    BlockRead,
    ExerciseReport,
    NetworkLink,
    RuntimePower,
    SensorReads,
    device_exercise,
)


def _deadline(sec=5.0):
    return time.monotonic() + sec


@pytest.fixture
def no_wait(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "LINK_SETTLE_SEC", 0.0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "SUSPEND_WAIT_SEC", 0.3)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "RESUME_WAIT_SEC", 0.3)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "_settle_udev", lambda: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "NETWORKD_LINKS", tmp_path / "networkd")
    sysnet = tmp_path / "procsys"
    (sysnet / "ipv6" / "conf" / "eno4").mkdir(parents=True)
    (sysnet / "ipv6" / "conf" / "eno4" / "disable_ipv6").write_text("0")
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "PROC_SYS_NET", sysnet)
    return sysnet


# --- network ---------------------------------------------------------------


class FakeIp:
    """ip(8) stand-in that flips IFF_UP in the fake sysfs flags file."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        net,
        addresses="",
        stick_up=False,
        slaac="",
        sticky_addr=False,
        up_times_out=False,
        sysnet=None,
    ):
        self.net, self.addresses, self.stick_up = net, addresses, stick_up
        self.slaac, self.sticky_addr, self.up_times_out = (
            slaac,
            sticky_addr,
            up_times_out,
        )
        self.sysnet, self.ipv6_during_up = sysnet, None
        self.calls = []

    def __call__(self, argv, **kwargs):
        import subprocess

        self.calls.append(argv[1:])
        if argv[1:3] == ["link", "set"]:
            flags = int((self.net / "flags").read_text(), 16)
            if argv[-1] == "up":
                if self.sysnet:
                    self.ipv6_during_up = (
                        self.sysnet / "ipv6/conf/eno4/disable_ipv6"
                    ).read_text()
                flags |= 1
                if self.slaac:
                    self.addresses = self.slaac  # autoconfig happened
                if self.up_times_out:
                    (self.net / "flags").write_text(hex(flags))
                    raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(argv, 5)
            elif not self.stick_up:
                flags &= ~1
            (self.net / "flags").write_text(hex(flags))
        if argv[1:3] == ["addr", "flush"] and not self.sticky_addr:
            self.addresses = ""
        out = self.addresses if argv[1:4] == ["-o", "addr", "show"] else ""
        return SimpleNamespace(returncode=0, stdout=out)


def _nic(tmp_path, flags="0x1002"):
    device = tmp_path / "dev0"
    net = device / "net" / "eno4"
    (net / "statistics").mkdir(parents=True)
    (net / "flags").write_text(flags)
    (net / "ifindex").write_text("3")
    (net / "statistics" / "rx_packets").write_text("0")
    return device, net


def _with_ip(monkeypatch, fake):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        exercise.shutil,
        "which",
        lambda name: None if name == "nmcli" else f"/usr/bin/{name}",
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise.subprocess, "run", fake)


def test_down_unused_interface_is_brought_up_and_restored(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, no_wait
):
    device, net = _nic(tmp_path)
    fake = FakeIp(net, sysnet=no_wait)
    _with_ip(monkeypatch, fake)
    report = ExerciseReport()
    NetworkLink().run(device, report, _deadline())
    assert ["link", "set", "dev", "eno4", "up"] in fake.calls
    assert ["link", "set", "dev", "eno4", "down"] in fake.calls
    assert report.ran and not report.not_restored
    assert int((net / "flags").read_text(), 16) & 1 == 0
    # IPv6 off while up (no DAD/RS/SLAAC), restored afterwards.
    assert fake.ipv6_during_up == "1"
    assert (no_wait / "ipv6/conf/eno4/disable_ipv6").read_text() == "0"


def test_autoconfigured_address_is_flushed(tmp_path, monkeypatch, no_wait):
    device, net = _nic(tmp_path)
    fake = FakeIp(net, slaac="3: eno4 inet 10.9.9.9/24")
    _with_ip(monkeypatch, fake)
    report = ExerciseReport()
    NetworkLink().run(device, report, _deadline())
    assert ["addr", "flush", "dev", "eno4"] in fake.calls
    assert not report.not_restored


def test_address_that_cannot_be_removed_is_reported(tmp_path, monkeypatch, no_wait):

    _with_ip(
        monkeypatch, FakeIp(net, slaac="3: eno4 inet 10.9.9.9/24", sticky_addr=True)
    )

# --- runtime PM ----------------------------------------------------------


def _power(tmp_path, control="on", delay="100"):
    device = tmp_path / "dev0"
    power = device / "power"
    power.mkdir(parents=True)
    (device / "config").write_bytes(b"\x86\x80" + b"\0" * 62)
    (power / "control").write_text(control)
    (power / "autosuspend_delay_ms").write_text(delay)
    (power / "runtime_status").write_text("active")
    return device, power


def test_runtime_suspend_resume_restores_settings(tmp_path, no_wait, monkeypatch):
    device, power = _power(tmp_path)
    real_read = exercise._read

    def read(path):  # the kernel suspends once control is "auto"
        if path.name == "runtime_status" and real_read(power / "control") == "auto":
            return "suspended"
        return real_read(path)

    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "_read", read)
    report = ExerciseReport()
    RuntimePower().run(device, report, _deadline())
    assert report.ran == ["runtime suspend/resume"]
    assert (power / "control").read_text() == "on"
    assert (power / "autosuspend_delay_ms").read_text() == "100"
    assert not report.not_restored


def test_device_lost_after_resume_is_reported(tmp_path, no_wait):
    device, power = _power(tmp_path)
    (device / "config").write_bytes(b"\xff\xff" + b"\xff" * 62)  # gone (D3cold)
    report = ExerciseReport()
    RuntimePower().run(device, report, _deadline())
    assert any("did not resume" in n for n in report.not_restored)


def test_device_link_consumer_is_not_suspended(tmp_path, no_wait):

    report = ExerciseReport()

    assert any("supplier link" in s for s in report.skipped)
    assert (power / "control").read_text() == "on"


def test_device_that_never_suspends_is_skipped_and_restored(tmp_path, no_wait):
    device, power = _power(tmp_path, control="auto", delay="2000")
    report = ExerciseReport()
    RuntimePower().run(device, report, _deadline())
    assert any("did not suspend" in s for s in report.skipped)
    assert (power / "control").read_text() == "auto"
    assert (power / "autosuspend_delay_ms").read_text() == "2000"

def test_block_read_reads_only_disks_of_this_device(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    device = tmp_path / "sys" / "dev0"
    disk = device / "nvme" / "nvme0" / "nvme0n1"
    disk.mkdir(parents=True)
    other = tmp_path / "sys" / "dev1" / "sda"
    other.mkdir(parents=True)
    block = tmp_path / "sys" / "block"
    block.mkdir()
    (block / "nvme0n1").symlink_to(disk)
    (block / "sda").symlink_to(other)
    dev = tmp_path / "dev"
    dev.mkdir()
    (dev / "nvme0n1").write_bytes(b"\0" * 8192)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "SYSFS_BLOCK", block)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise, "DEV_ROOT", dev)
    opened = []
    real_open = exercise.os.open

    def tracking_open(path, flags, *args):
        opened.append((str(path), flags))
        return real_open(path, flags, *args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise.os, "open", tracking_open)
    report = ExerciseReport()
    BlockRead().run(device, report, _deadline())
    assert report.ran == ["block read nvme0n1"]
    assert all(path.endswith("nvme0n1") for path, _ in opened)
    assert all(
        not flags & (exercise.os.O_WRONLY | exercise.os.O_RDWR) for _, flags in opened
    )

# --- selection ---------------------------------------------------------


class Recorder(exercise.Exerciser):
    def __init__(self, name, cls=None, boom=False):
        self.name, self.cls, self.boom, self.ran = name, cls, boom, False

    def applies(self, device, class_code):
        return self.cls is None or class_code >> 16 == self.cls

    def run(self, device, report, deadline):
        self.ran = True
        if self.boom:
            raise RuntimeError("broken workload")
        report.ran.append(self.name)


def test_exercisers_selected_by_class_and_isolated(tmp_path, no_wait):
    device = tmp_path / "dev0"
    device.mkdir()
    (device / "class").write_text("0x010802\n")  # NVMe
    net, block, broken, generic = (
        Recorder("net", 0x02),
        Recorder("block", 0x01),
        Recorder("broken", boom=True),
        Recorder("generic"),
    )
    report = device_exercise(device, (net, block, broken, generic))(_deadline())
    assert not net.ran and block.ran and generic.ran
    assert report.ran == ["block", "generic"]
    assert any("broken workload" in s for s in report.skipped)


def test_exercise_can_be_disabled_by_environment(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv(exercise.EXERCISE_ENV, "0")
    assert not exercise.exercise_enabled()
    monkeypatch.delenv(exercise.EXERCISE_ENV)
    assert exercise.exercise_enabled()


# --- inside the capture -------------------------------------------------


def test_exercise_runs_inside_the_trace_and_reports(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect import mmiotrace

    cpus = tmp_path / "cpu"
    cpus.mkdir()
    (cpus / "online").write_text("0\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "CPU_ONLINE", cpus / "online")
    root = tmp_path / "tracing"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "available_tracers").write_text("nop mmiotrace\n")
    (root / "set_event").write_text("")
    (root / "current_tracer").write_text("nop\n")
    (root / "tracing_on").write_text("1\n")
    (root / "trace_pipe").write_text(
        "MAP 0.1 1 0xf7e00000 0xffff 0x4000 0x0 0\n" "R 4 0.2 1 0xf7e00000 0x0 0x0 0\n"
    )
    seen = []

    def run_exercise(deadline):
        seen.append((root / "current_tracer").read_text().strip())
        report = ExerciseReport(
            ran=["fake"], skipped=["block read: no disk"], not_restored=["eno4 left up"]
        )
        return report

    result = mmiotrace.capture_native_probe(
        "0000:03:00.0",
        [mmiotrace.BarResource(bar_index=0, physical_start=0xF7E00000, size=0x4000)],
        duration_sec=0,
        tracefs=root,
        rebind=lambda after: None,
        journal_dir=tmp_path / "j",
        exercise=run_exercise,
    )
    assert seen == ["mmiotrace"]
    assert "exercised: fake" in result.notes
    assert result.host_changes == ["eno4 left up"]
    assert result.exercises_run == ["fake"]
    assert result.exercises_skipped == ["block read: no disk"]


def test_overrunning_exercise_cannot_keep_cpus_offline(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import threading

    from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect import mmiotrace

    cpus = tmp_path / "cpu"
    cpus.mkdir()
    (cpus / "online").write_text("0\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "CPU_ONLINE", cpus / "online")
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "EXERCISE_BUDGET_SEC", 0.1)
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "EXERCISE_GRACE_SEC", 0.1)
    root = tmp_path / "tracing"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "available_tracers").write_text("nop mmiotrace\n")
    (root / "set_event").write_text("")
    (root / "current_tracer").write_text("nop\n")
    (root / "tracing_on").write_text("1\n")
    (root / "trace_pipe").write_text("MAP 0.1 1 0xf7e00000 0xffff 0x4000 0x0 0\n")
    release = threading.Event()
    tracer_when_done = []

    def stuck(deadline):
        release.wait(5)  # e.g. a read stuck in a disk timeout
        tracer_when_done.append((root / "current_tracer").read_text().strip())
        return ExerciseReport(ran=["late"])

    threading.Timer(0.6, release.set).start()
    # An undo that outlives every bounded wait is a restoration incident:
    # it blocks the build, and later captures refuse until it is checked.
    with pytest.raises(mmiotrace.HostRestorationError, match="did not finish"):
        mmiotrace.capture_native_probe(
            "0000:03:00.0",
            [
                mmiotrace.BarResource(
                    bar_index=0, physical_start=0xF7E00000, size=0x4000
                )
            ],
            duration_sec=0,
            tracefs=root,
            rebind=lambda after: None,
            journal_dir=tmp_path / "j",
            exercise=stuck,
        )
    assert (root / "current_tracer").read_text().strip() == "nop"
    journal = tmp_path / "j" / "tracer" / mmiotrace.TRACER_JOURNAL
    assert "incident" in journal.read_text()
    release.wait(5)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 2
    while not tracer_when_done and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.05)
    assert tracer_when_done == ["nop"]  # tracer was stopped before it finished


def test_slow_exercise_undo_is_awaited_after_the_tracer_stops(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import threading

    from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect import mmiotrace

    cpus = tmp_path / "cpu"
    cpus.mkdir()
    (cpus / "online").write_text("0\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "CPU_ONLINE", cpus / "online")
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "EXERCISE_BUDGET_SEC", 0.2)
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "EXERCISE_GRACE_SEC", 0.0)
    root = tmp_path / "tracing"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "available_tracers").write_text("nop mmiotrace\n")
    (root / "set_event").write_text("")
    (root / "current_tracer").write_text("nop\n")
    (root / "tracing_on").write_text("1\n")
    (root / "trace_pipe").write_text("MAP 0.1 1 0xf7e00000 0xffff 0x4000 0x0 0\n")

    def slow(deadline):
        threading.Event().wait(0.35)  # past the budget, within the final wait
        return ExerciseReport(ran=["slow"])

    result = mmiotrace.capture_native_probe(
        "0000:03:00.0",
        [mmiotrace.BarResource(bar_index=0, physical_start=0xF7E00000, size=0x4000)],
        duration_sec=0,
        tracefs=root,
        rebind=lambda after: None,
        journal_dir=tmp_path / "j",
        exercise=slow,
    )
    assert any("exceeded its budget" in n for n in result.notes)
    assert result.exercises_run == ["slow"]
    assert not (tmp_path / "j" / "tracer" / mmiotrace.TRACER_JOURNAL).exists()

def test_unanswered_nmcli_is_treated_as_managed(tmp_path, monkeypatch, no_wait):
    device, net = _nic(tmp_path)
    fake = FakeIp(net)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise.shutil, "which", lambda name: f"/usr/bin/{name}")

    def run(argv, **kwargs):
        if argv[0].endswith("nmcli"):
            import subprocess

            raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(argv, 5)
        return fake(argv, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(exercise.subprocess, "run", run)
    report = ExerciseReport()
    NetworkLink().run(device, report, _deadline())
    assert not any(c[:2] == ["link", "set"] for c in fake.calls)
    assert any("NetworkManager (state unknown)" in s for s in report.skipped)
```

```py
import os

"""MMIO capture process lifecycle tested exclusively with fake processes."""

import signal
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from pcileechfwgenerator.device_clone import mmio_tracer as module

TRACE = (
    "REGISTER_OBSERVER_V1\n"
    "map,123,10,,0xffffc90000100000,,0x80000000,4096,,\n"
    "read_enter,123,11,4,0xffffc90000100010,,,,11,\n"
    "read_return,123,12,4,0xffffc90000100010,85,,,11,ok\n"
    "write,456,13,4,0xffffc90000200000,85,,,,\n"
)


class FakeProcess:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        stdout,
        stderr,
        text,
        trace=TRACE,
        diagnostic="",
        early=None,
        stubborn=False,
        final_code=-signal.SIGTERM,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        self.output_path = Path(stdout.name)
        self.error_path = Path(stderr.name)
        stdout.write(trace)
        stdout.flush()
        stderr.write(diagnostic)
        stderr.flush()
        self.returncode = early
        self.stubborn = stubborn
        self.final_code = final_code
        self.terminated = self.killed = self.reaped = False
        self.poll_count = 0
        self.exit_on_poll = None

    def poll(self):
        self.poll_count += 1
        if self.exit_on_poll == self.poll_count:
            self.returncode = 1
        return self.returncode

    def terminate(self):
        self.terminated = True
        if not self.stubborn:
            self.returncode = self.final_code

    def kill(self):
        self.killed = True
        self.returncode = -signal.SIGKILL

    def wait(self, timeout=None):
        if self.returncode is None:
            raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired("fake bpftrace", timeout)
        self.reaped = True
        return self.returncode


@pytest.fixture
def capture(monkeypatch):
    tracer = object.__new__(module.MmioTracer)
    tracer.device_bdf = "0000:03:00.0"
    monkeypatch.setattr(tracer, "_get_bar_info", lambda index: (0x80000000, 4096))
    instances = []
    options = {}
    clock = [0.0]
    monkeypatch.setattr(module.time, "monotonic", lambda: clock[0])
    monkeypatch.setattr(module.time, "monotonic_ns", lambda: int(clock[0] * 1e9))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        module.time, "sleep", lambda duration: clock.__setitem__(0, clock[0] + duration)
    )

    def popen(argv, **kwargs):
        assert argv[:4] == ["bpftrace", "-q", "-B", "line"]
        assert "shell" not in kwargs
        proc = FakeProcess(**kwargs, **options)
        instances.append(proc)
        return proc

    monkeypatch.setattr(module.subprocess, "Popen", popen)
    return tracer, options, instances

    assert not proc.output_path.exists() and not proc.error_path.exists()

# --- The optional rebind restores and verifies the exact driver -------


class _DriverState:
    def __init__(self, driver="e1000e"):
        self.driver = driver
        self.fail = set()
        self.writes = []


def _rebind_tracer(monkeypatch, state, root=None):
    tracer = object.__new__(module.MmioTracer)
    tracer.device_bdf = "0000:03:00.0"
    if root is not None:
        monkeypatch.setattr(module.MmioTracer, "SYSFS_ROOT", root / "sys")
        monkeypatch.setattr(module.MmioTracer, "PROC_ROOT", root / "proc")
        monkeypatch.setattr(module.MmioTracer, "DEV_ROOT", root / "dev")
        (root / "sys" / "block").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        mountinfo = root / "proc" / "self" / "mountinfo"
        if not mountinfo.exists():
            mountinfo.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            mountinfo.write_text("")
        pid_ns = root / "proc" / "self" / "ns" / "pid"
        if not pid_ns.is_symlink():
            pid_ns.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            pid_ns.symlink_to(module.MmioTracer.INIT_PID_NS)
        # Down interfaces carry no configuration unless a test says so.
        monkeypatch.setattr(
            module.MmioTracer, "_configured_interface", lambda self, net: None
        )
    monkeypatch.setattr(module.time, "sleep", lambda _s: None)

    def write(path, value):
        state.writes.append(path)
        if path.endswith("/unbind"):
            if "unbind" in state.fail:
                raise OSError("injected unbind")
            state.driver = None
            if "interrupt" in state.fail:
                raise KeyboardInterrupt
        elif path.endswith("/bind"):
            if "bind" in state.fail:
                raise OSError("injected bind")
            if "defer" in state.fail:
                state.fail.discard("defer")
                state.deferred = path.split("/")[-2]
                raise OSError(517, "probe deferred")
            state.driver = path.split("/")[-2]
        else:
            raise AssertionError("unexpected sysfs write " + path)

    def current():
        if getattr(state, "deferred", None):
            state.driver, state.deferred = state.deferred, None
            return None  # first poll: still deferred
        return state.driver

    monkeypatch.setattr(tracer, "_current_driver", current)
    monkeypatch.setattr(tracer, "_sysfs_write", write)
    return tracer


def test_rebind_restores_exact_driver_without_rescan(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    state = _DriverState()
    _rebind_tracer(monkeypatch, state, tmp_path)._trigger_driver_rebind()
    assert state.driver == "e1000e"
    assert state.writes == [
        str(tmp_path / "sys/bus/pci/drivers/e1000e/unbind"),
        str(tmp_path / "sys/bus/pci/drivers/e1000e/bind"),
    ]
    assert not any("rescan" in w for w in state.writes)

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="left it on no driver.*injected bind"):

def _device(root, **files):
    device = root / "sys" / "bus" / "pci" / "devices" / "0000:03:00.0"
    device.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = device / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text)
    return device


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "files,reason",
    [
        ({"driver_override": "vfio-pci\n"}, "driver_override is vfio-pci"),
        ({"sriov_numvfs": "4\n"}, "SR-IOV"),
        ({"boot_vga": "1\n"}, "display"),
        ({"drm/card0/dev": "226:0"}, "display"),
        ({"net/eth0/flags": "0x1003\n"}, "eth0 is up"),
        # Configured up without carrier is still in use.
        (
            {"net/eth0/flags": "0x1003\n", "net/eth0/operstate": "down\n"},
            "eth0 is up",
        ),
        ({"sriov_numvfs/unreadable": ""}, "cannot verify"),
        ({"nvme/nvme0/block/nvme0n1/holders/dm-0": ""}, "nvme0n1 has holders"),
        (
            {
                "nvme/nvme0/block/nvme0n1/dev": "259:0",
                "nvme/nvme0/block/nvme0n1/nvme0n1p2/partition": "2",
                "nvme/nvme0/block/nvme0n1/nvme0n1p2/dev": "259:2",
            },
            "nvme0n1p2 is mounted",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_rebind_refuses_devices_in_use(monkeypatch, tmp_path, files, reason):

def test_exclusively_claimed_block_device_refuses_rebind(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    """A ZFS vdev has no mount, holder or swap entry; only its claim shows."""
    import errno

    _disk(tmp_path)
    real_open = module.os.open

    def claimed(path, flags, *args):
        if str(path).endswith("/dev/nvme0n1") and flags & module.os.O_EXCL:

        return real_open(path, flags, *args)

def test_nvme_namespace_outside_a_block_dir_is_checked(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    """NVMe namespaces sit at nvme/nvme0/nvme0n1; found through /sys/block."""
    import errno

    _device(tmp_path, **{"nvme/nvme0/nvme0n1/dev": "259:0"})
    device = tmp_path / "sys" / "bus" / "pci" / "devices" / "0000:03:00.0"
    block = tmp_path / "sys" / "block"
    block.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (block / "nvme0n1").symlink_to(device / "nvme" / "nvme0" / "nvme0n1")
    (device / "nvme" / "nvme0" / "nvme0n1" / "nvme0n1p1").mkdir()
    (device / "nvme" / "nvme0" / "nvme0n1" / "nvme0n1p1" / "partition").write_text("1")
    real_open = module.os.open

    def zfs_member(path, flags, *args):
        if str(path).endswith("/dev/nvme0n1p1") and flags & module.os.O_EXCL:
            raise OSError(errno.EBUSY, "Device or resource busy")
        return real_open(path, flags, *args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(module.os, "open", zfs_member)
    dev = tmp_path / "dev"
    dev.mkdir()
    (dev / "nvme0n1").write_text("")
    (dev / "nvme0n1p1").write_text("")
    state = _DriverState()
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="nvme0n1p1 is claimed"):
        _rebind_tracer(monkeypatch, state, tmp_path)._trigger_driver_rebind()
    assert state.writes == []


def test_open_device_node_refuses_rebind(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    """e.g. a sound server holding /dev/snd/pcmC1D3p of the donor."""
    import os as _os
    import stat as _stat
    from types import SimpleNamespace

    _device(tmp_path, **{"sound/card1/pcmC1D3p/dev": "116:5"})
    proc = tmp_path / "proc" / "777"
    (proc / "fd").mkdir(parents=True)
    (proc / "comm").write_text("pipewire\n")
    (proc / "fd" / "9").write_text("")
    real_stat = module.os.stat

    def fake_stat(path, *args, **kwargs):
        if str(path).endswith("/777/fd/9"):
            return SimpleNamespace(
                st_mode=_stat.S_IFCHR | 0o600, st_rdev=_os.makedev(116, 5)
            )
        return real_stat(path, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(module.os, "stat", fake_stat)
    state = _DriverState()
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="open by pipewire"):
        _rebind_tracer(monkeypatch, state, tmp_path)._trigger_driver_rebind()
    assert state.writes == []


def _nvme_disk(tmp_path, *, multipath=False):
    """An NVMe namespace with a /dev node; optionally behind native multipath."""
    device = tmp_path / "sys" / "bus" / "pci" / "devices" / "0000:03:00.0"
    block = tmp_path / "sys" / "block"
    block.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if multipath:
        _device(tmp_path, **{"nvme/nvme0/nvme0c0n1/dev": "0:0"})
        head = tmp_path / "sys" / "devices" / "virtual" / "nvme-subsystem" / "nvme0n1"
        (head / "multipath").mkdir(parents=True)
        (head / "dev").write_text("259:0")
        (head / "multipath" / "nvme0c0n1").symlink_to(
            device / "nvme" / "nvme0" / "nvme0c0n1"
        )
        (block / "nvme0n1").symlink_to(head)
    else:
        _device(tmp_path, **{"nvme/nvme0/nvme0n1/dev": "259:0"})
        (block / "nvme0n1").symlink_to(device / "nvme" / "nvme0" / "nvme0n1")
    dev = tmp_path / "dev"
    dev.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (dev / "nvme0n1").write_text("")

def test_multipath_head_found_by_kernel_naming(monkeypatch, tmp_path):

def test_disk_claims_are_held_across_the_unbind(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    _nvme_disk(tmp_path)
    held = []
    real_open, real_close = os.open, os.close
    opened = set()

    dev_root = str(tmp_path / "dev")

    def fake_open(path, flags, *a):
        if not str(path).startswith(dev_root):
            return real_open(path, flags, *a)
        fd = real_open(path, os.O_RDONLY)  # fake node: a regular file
        opened.add(fd)
        return fd

    def fake_close(fd):
        opened.discard(fd)
        real_close(fd)

    monkeypatch.setattr(module.os, "open", fake_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(module.os, "close", fake_close)
    state = _DriverState()
    tracer = _rebind_tracer(monkeypatch, state, tmp_path)
    original_write = tracer._sysfs_write

    def write(path, value):
        if path.endswith("/unbind"):
            held.append(len(opened))
        original_write(path, value)

    tracer._sysfs_write = write
    tracer._trigger_driver_rebind()
    # An exclusive claim on the disk is open at the moment of the unbind,
    # and released afterwards.
    assert held == [1] and not opened

```

`tests/test_mmiotrace_learning.py`:

```py
"""Passive learning from the native driver: mmiotrace -> inferred RW -> BAR RTL.

Synthetic traces only; no tracer, driver or device is touched.
"""

import logging

import pytest
from pcileechfwgenerator.device_clone.register_classifier import classify_register
from pcileechfwgenerator.device_clone.register_evidence import (
    Observation,
    RegisterRef,
)
from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect import mmiotrace
from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect.mmiotrace import (
    ObserverUnavailable,
    capture_native_probe,
    parse_mmiotrace,
)
from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect.register_observer import BarResource

BAR0 = BarResource(bar_index=0, physical_start=0xF7E00000, size=0x4000)

# Driver probe: read ID (RO), read CTRL (0), set enable bit and read it back
# twice, write-then-read a scratch register in both directions, poke a status
# bit (W1C-like: writing 1 reads back 0), and another device's traffic.
PROBE = """\
VERSION 20070824
PCIDEV 0300 80861533 b 0 f7e00000 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 20000 0 0 0 0 0 0 e1000e
MAP 0.000100 1 0xf7e00000 0xffffc90000a00000 0x4000 0x0 0
R 4 0.000200 1 0xf7e00008 0x8086beef 0x0 0
R 4 0.000300 1 0xf7e00000 0x0 0x0 0
W 4 0.000400 1 0xf7e00000 0x1 0x0 0
R 4 0.000500 1 0xf7e00000 0x1 0x0 0
R 4 0.000550 1 0xf7e00000 0x1 0x0 0
R 4 0.000600 1 0xf7e00010 0x0 0x0 0
W 4 0.000700 1 0xf7e00010 0xa5a5a5a5 0x0 0
R 4 0.000800 1 0xf7e00010 0xa5a5a5a5 0x0 0
R 4 0.000850 1 0xf7e00010 0xa5a5a5a5 0x0 0
W 4 0.000900 1 0xf7e00010 0x5a5a5a5a 0x0 0
R 4 0.001000 1 0xf7e00010 0x5a5a5a5a 0x0 0
R 4 0.001050 1 0xf7e00010 0x5a5a5a5a 0x0 0
R 4 0.001100 1 0xf7e00020 0x4 0x0 0
W 4 0.001200 1 0xf7e00020 0x4 0x0 0
R 4 0.001300 1 0xf7e00020 0x0 0x0 0
R 4 0.001400 2 0xfe000000 0x12345678 0x0 0
UNMAP 0.002000 1 0x0 0
"""


def test_parser_attributes_donor_accesses_and_ignores_other_devices():
    result = parse_mmiotrace(PROBE.splitlines(), [BAR0])
    assert result.dropped_events == 0
    assert len(result.observations) == 15
    assert result.mapped_bars == [0]
    first = result.observations[0]
    assert (first.operation, first.ref.offset, first.returned_value) == (
        "read",
        8,
        0x8086BEEF,
    )
    assert first.source == "native_driver" and first.mediation == "physical"
    assert first.monotonic_ns == 200_000
    assert all(o.ref.bar_index == 0 for o in result.observations)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "line,counter",
    [
        ("MARK 0.000000 Lost 17 events.", "lost_events"),
        ("mmiotrace has lost events", "lost_events"),
        ("UNKNOWN 0.0001 1 0xf7e00004 0x0 0x0 0", "discarded_observations"),
        ("R 4 0.0001 1 0xf7e00002 0x0 0x0 0", "unattributed_accesses"),
        ("R 4 0.0001 1 0xf7e03ffe 0x0 0x0 0", "unattributed_accesses"),
        ("R four 0.0001 1 0xf7e00000 0x0 0x0 0", "malformed_lines"),
        ("BOGUS 1 2 3", "malformed_lines"),
    ],
)
def test_parser_counts_anything_that_makes_the_trace_incomplete(line, counter):
    result = parse_mmiotrace([line], [BAR0])
    assert getattr(result, counter) >= 1 and result.dropped_events >= 1
    assert not result.observations

    assert result.lost_events == 17


# --- capture against a fake tracefs ---------------------------------------


@pytest.fixture
def host(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Fake CPU hotplug state: tracing takes CPUs 1-3 offline."""
    cpus = tmp_path / "cpu"
    for n in range(4):
        (cpus / f"cpu{n}").mkdir(parents=True)
    online = cpus / "online"
    online.write_text("0-3\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "CPU_ONLINE", online)
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "CPU_DIR", cpus)

    def set_online(cpu):  # what the kernel does on cpuN/online <- 1
        (cpus / f"cpu{cpu}" / "online").write_text("1")
        current = mmiotrace._cpu_set(online.read_text()) | {cpu}
        online.write_text(",".join(str(c) for c in sorted(current)) + "\n")

    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "_set_cpu_online", set_online)
    return online


def _tracefs(tmp_path, *, available="nop function mmiotrace", current="nop"):
    root = tmp_path / "tracing"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "available_tracers").write_text(available + "\n")
    (root / "set_event").write_text("")
    (root / "current_tracer").write_text(current + "\n")
    (root / "tracing_on").write_text("0\n")  # as found on a real host
    (root / "trace_pipe").write_text(PROBE)
    return root


def test_capture_enables_tracer_around_the_rebind_and_restores_nop(tmp_path, host):
    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)
    device = tmp_path / "device"
    device.mkdir()
    (device / "reset").write_text("")
    (device / "reset_method").write_text("flr pm\n")
    seen = []

    def rebind(after_unbind):
        seen.append((root / "current_tracer").read_text().strip())
        if len(seen) == 1:  # the traced probe
            assert (root / "tracing_on").read_text().strip() == "1"
            host.write_text("0\n")  # what mmiotrace does to the host
        assert (tmp_path / "j" / "tracer" / mmiotrace.TRACER_JOURNAL).exists()
        after_unbind()

    result = capture_native_probe(
        "0000:03:00.0",
        [BAR0],
        duration_sec=0,
        tracefs=root,
        rebind=rebind,
        sysfs_device=device,
        journal_dir=tmp_path / "j",
    )
    # Traced probe, then an untraced re-probe with every CPU back online so
    # the driver re-sizes per-CPU queues/vectors.
    assert seen == ["mmiotrace", "nop"]
    assert (device / "reset").read_text() == "1"  # function reset while unbound
    assert result.reset_performed is True
    assert (root / "current_tracer").read_text().strip() == "nop"
    assert (root / "tracing_on").read_text().strip() == "0"  # restored
    assert all(
        (host.parent / f"cpu{n}" / "online").read_text() == "1" for n in (1, 2, 3)
    )
    assert not (tmp_path / "j" / "tracer" / mmiotrace.TRACER_JOURNAL).exists()
    assert len(result.observations) == 15
    # The fake kernel log is unreadable, so loss cannot be ruled out.
    assert result.capture_incomplete >= 1

def test_bar_resources_skip_io_and_unassigned_bars():

# --- inference rule -------------------------------------------------------


def _ref(offset=0):
    return RegisterRef(
        space="mem_bar", bar_index=0, offset=offset, width=4, field_mask=0xFFFFFFFF
    )


def _native(pairs, **overrides):
    out = []
    for i, (op, value) in enumerate(pairs):
        fields = dict(
            sequence_id=i,
            monotonic_ns=i * 10,
            operation=op,
            ref=_ref(),
            completion="ok",
            source="native_driver",
            mediation="physical",
            state_epoch=0,
        )
        fields["returned_value" if op == "read" else "attempted_value"] = value
        fields.update(overrides)
        out.append(Observation(**fields))
    return out


def _rw(pairs, **overrides):
    return classify_register(_ref(), _native(pairs, **overrides)).mask_for(
        "rw", state_epoch=0
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "pairs,expected",
    [
        ([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 1), ("read", 1)], 1),  # set
        ([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 0), ("read", 1), ("read", 1)], 1),
        ([("read", 1), ("write", 0), ("read", 0), ("read", 0)], 1),  # cleared
        ([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 1)], 1),  # one flush read
        ([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 0)], 0),  # ignored write
        ([("read", 1), ("write", 1), ("read", 0)], 0),  # W1C / self-clearing
        ([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 1), ("read", 0)], 0),  # bounce
        ([("read", 0), ("read", 1), ("write", 0), ("read", 0)], 0),  # volatile
        ([("write", 1), ("read", 1)], 1),  # no known prior value
        ([("read", 0), ("write", 0), ("read", 0)], 1),  # no transition
        ([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("write", 0), ("read", 0)], 1),  # unread
        ([("write", 1)], 1),  # write-once: never read back
        ([("read", 0), ("read", 0)], 0),  # never written
    ],
)
def test_inferred_storage_rule(pairs, expected):
    assert _rw(pairs) & 1 == expected


def test_inference_needs_physical_native_driver_evidence():
    pairs = [("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 1), ("read", 1)]
    assert _rw(pairs) & 1
    assert _rw(pairs, mediation="unknown") == 0  # e.g. kprobe tracing
    assert _rw(pairs, source="simulator") == 0


def test_inferred_claim_names_its_evidence():
    result = classify_register(
        _ref(), _native([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 1), ("read", 1)])
    )
    claim = next(c for c in result.claims if c.semantic == "rw")
    assert claim.strength == "inferred" and claim.observation_ids
    assert "read back" in claim.note


def test_write_once_claim_says_it_was_never_read_back():
    result = classify_register(_ref(), _native([("read", 0), ("write", 1)]))
    claim = next(c for c in result.claims if c.semantic == "rw")
    assert claim.strength == "inferred" and "never read back" in claim.note


def _manifest(tmp_path, monkeypatch, *, dropped=0):
    from pcileechfwgenerator.host_collect.register_learning import (
        LearningDiscovery,
        LearningResource,
        run_register_learning,
    )

    config = bytearray(256)
    config[:4] = bytes.fromhex("86803315")
    discovery = LearningDiscovery.from_config(
        bytes(config), resources=(LearningResource(index=0, size=0x4000),)
    )

    def observer(_discovery, epoch):
        result = parse_mmiotrace(PROBE.splitlines(), [BAR0], state_epoch=epoch)
        result.lost_events += dropped
        return result

    return run_register_learning(
        "03:00.0",
        discover=lambda: discovery,
        journal_directory=tmp_path,
        passive_observer=observer,
    )


def test_native_probe_trace_becomes_a_servable_model(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from pcileechfwgenerator.device_clone.register_policy import (
        compile_manifest_bar_models,
        servable_models,
    )

    manifest = _manifest(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert manifest.status != "failed"
    result = compile_manifest_bar_models(manifest, [(0, 0x4000)])[0]
    model = servable_models({0: result})[0]
    regs = model.registers
    assert regs[0x8].rw_mask == 0 and regs[0x8].reset == 0x8086BEEF  # ID, RO
    # Writing 0x1 also writes 0 to the other bits, none contradicted.
    assert regs[0x0].rw_mask == 0xFFFFFFFF and regs[0x0].reset == 0
    # Scratch: every bit changed both ways and read back.
    assert regs[0x10].rw_mask == 0xFFFFFFFF and regs[0x10].reset == 0
    # W1C-like bit 2 read back 0 after writing 1: refused; the rest written 0.
    assert regs[0x20].rw_mask == 0xFFFFFFFB and regs[0x20].reset == 4
    assert result.coverage.inferred_bits == 32 + 32 + 31
    assert not any(g.reason == "initial_state_unverified" for g in manifest.gaps)


def test_incomplete_trace_grants_no_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from pcileechfwgenerator.device_clone.register_policy import (
        compile_manifest_bar_models,
    )

    manifest = _manifest(tmp_path, monkeypatch, dropped=1)
    results = compile_manifest_bar_models(manifest, [(0, 0x4000)], include_empty=True)
    model = results[0].model
    assert all(r.rw_mask == 0 for r in model.registers.values())
    # A lost write could precede any read: no value counts as reset state.
    assert all(r.reset == 0 for r in model.registers.values())

def test_shutdown_failure_replaces_an_error_in_flight(tmp_path, host, monkeypatch):
    """A refused rebind must not hide a tracer that could not be stopped."""
    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "_stop_tracer", lambda *a: "stuck")

    def refuse(_after):
        raise RuntimeError("Refusing to rebind: in use")

    with pytest.raises(mmiotrace.HostRestorationError, match="stuck"):
        _capture(tmp_path, root, refuse)


def test_failed_rebind_is_a_restoration_failure(tmp_path, host):
    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)

    def broken(_after):
        raise RuntimeError("Driver rebind left it on no driver")

    with pytest.raises(mmiotrace.HostRestorationError, match="no driver"):
        _capture(tmp_path, root, broken)
    assert (root / "current_tracer").read_text().strip() == "nop"


def test_concurrent_capture_is_refused(tmp_path, host):
    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)
    # One host-wide lock, whatever journal directory each run uses.
    with mmiotrace._HostLock(mmiotrace.HOST_LOCK):
        with pytest.raises(ObserverUnavailable, match="another"):
            _capture(tmp_path, root, lambda after: pytest.fail("ran"))
    assert (root / "current_tracer").read_text().strip() == "nop"


def test_stalled_probe_stops_tracing_at_the_deadline(tmp_path, host, monkeypatch):
    import time

    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(mmiotrace, "PROBE_DEADLINE_SEC", 0.2)
    states = []

    def stalled(_after):
        # Stall until tracing is switched off (bounded). Released on the
        # event, not on a wall-clock timer, so a slow host cannot let the
        # probe finish inside the deadline. If capture waited on the probe
        # before stopping the tracer, this would time out and still read
        # "mmiotrace".
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        tracer = root / "current_tracer"
        while tracer.read_text().strip() != "nop" and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.01)
        states.append(tracer.read_text().strip())

    result = _capture(tmp_path, root, stalled)
    # Tracer was already off when the probe ended. That late probe ran with
    # every CPU back, so no restoring re-probe is needed (or attempted).
    assert states == ["nop"]
    assert any("deadline" in n for n in result.notes)
    assert result.dropped_events >= 1


def test_unaligned_mapping_marks_trace_incomplete():
    trace = PROBE.replace("MAP 0.000100 1 0xf7e00000", "MAP 0.000100 1 0xf7e00010")
    result = parse_mmiotrace(trace.splitlines(), [BAR0])
    assert result.capture_incomplete == 1 and result.dropped_events >= 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "line,trouble",
    [
        ("6,1,2,-;kmmio: recursive probe hit on CPU 0", True),
        ("4,2,3,-;mmiotrace: Unable to set page fault", True),
        ("4,2,3,-;mmiotrace: Error taking CPU1 down: -16", True),
        # Logged by the kernel when the ring buffer refuses records.
        ("4,5,6,-;mmiotrace has lost events", True),
        ("6,3,4,-;mmiotrace: enabled CPU1.", False),
        ("6,3,4,-;mmiotrace: MMIO tracing disabled.", False),
    ],
)
def test_kernel_log_trouble_patterns(line, trouble):
    text = line.split(";", 1)[1]
    assert bool(mmiotrace._KMSG_TROUBLE.search(text)) is trouble


def test_mismatched_read_back_is_refused_even_after_writes_elsewhere():
    """Index/data: a read-back of another index's data contradicts storage."""
    data = _native([("read", 0), ("write", 1), ("read", 0)])
    index = Observation(
        sequence_id=10,
        monotonic_ns=15,
        operation="write",
        ref=RegisterRef(
            space="mem_bar", bar_index=0, offset=4, width=4, field_mask=0xFFFFFFFF
        ),
        attempted_value=3,
        completion="ok",
        source="native_driver",
        mediation="physical",
        state_epoch=0,
    )
    result = classify_register(_ref(), [*data, index])
    assert result.mask_for("rw", state_epoch=0) & 1 == 0


def test_msix_table_and_pba_are_left_out_of_learned_evidence():
    config = bytearray(256)
    config[0x34] = 0x40
    config[0x40:0x42] = bytes([0x11, 0x00])  # MSI-X, next = 0
    config[0x42:0x44] = (3).to_bytes(2, "little")  # 4 entries
    config[0x44:0x48] = (0x2000 | 0).to_bytes(4, "little")  # table BAR0+0x2000
    config[0x48:0x4C] = (0x3000 | 0).to_bytes(4, "little")  # PBA BAR0+0x3000
    config[0x06] = 0x10  # capability list present
    ranges = mmiotrace.msix_ranges(bytes(config))
    assert ranges == [(0, 0x2000, 0x2040), (0, 0x3000, 0x3008)]
    trace = PROBE + "R 4 0.003000 1 0xf7e02000 0x0 0x0 0\n"
    result = parse_mmiotrace(trace.splitlines(), [BAR0])
    before = len(result.observations)
    mmiotrace.drop_reserved_ranges(result, ranges)
    assert len(result.observations) == before - 1
    assert all(o.ref.offset != 0x2000 for o in result.observations)
    # Not served by anything: reported, never presented as handled.
    assert len(result.excluded_ranges) == 2
    assert all("not served" in r for r in result.excluded_ranges)

        compile_manifest_bar_models,

        "03:00.0",
        discover=lambda: discovery,
        journal_directory=tmp_path,

def test_written_before_read_register_is_served_from_zero_and_labelled(tmp_path):

def test_partly_contradicted_or_incomplete_register_is_not_invented(tmp_path):
    # A self-clearing bit means not every bit is storage: value unknown.
    result = _compile_one([("write", 1), ("read", 0)], tmp_path=tmp_path / "a")
    assert 0 not in result.model.registers
    # A lossy trace grants nothing, so nothing is invented either.
    result = _compile_one([("write", 2)], 1, tmp_path=tmp_path / "b")
    assert 0 not in result.model.registers

def test_failed_restoring_reprobe_is_reported(tmp_path, host):
    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)
    calls = []

    def rebind(after):
        calls.append(1)
        if len(calls) == 2:
            raise RuntimeError("Refusing to rebind: device busy")
        after()

    result = _capture(tmp_path, root, rebind)
    assert len(calls) == 2
    # Refused: the driver stayed bound, with its one-CPU configuration.
    assert any("re-probe refused" in c for c in result.host_changes)
    assert not (tmp_path / "j" / "tracer" / mmiotrace.TRACER_JOURNAL).exists()


def test_restoring_reprobe_failure_blocks_and_marks_an_incident(tmp_path, host):
    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)
    calls = []

    def rebind(after):
        calls.append(1)
        if len(calls) == 2:
            raise RuntimeError("Driver rebind left it on no driver")
        after()

    with pytest.raises(mmiotrace.HostRestorationError, match="re-probe failed"):
        _capture(tmp_path, root, rebind)
    journal = tmp_path / "j" / "tracer" / mmiotrace.TRACER_JOURNAL
    assert "incident" in journal.read_text()
    # The next capture refuses until an operator checks the device.
    with pytest.raises(
        mmiotrace.HostRestorationError, match="did not finish restoring"
    ):
        _capture(tmp_path, root, lambda after: pytest.fail("ran"))

def test_journal_from_a_previous_boot_is_discarded(tmp_path, host, monkeypatch):
    root = _tracefs(tmp_path)

        '{"cpus_online": [0, 1], "tracing_on": "0", "boot_id": "old-boot"}'

    assert (root / "tracing_on").read_text().strip() == "1"  # untouched

    from pcileechfwgenerator.device_clone.register_policy import _initial_in_epoch

def test_msix_exclusion_fails_closed_on_an_unreadable_capability_chain():
    config = bytearray(256)
    config[0x06] = 0x10
    config[0x34] = 0x40
    config[0x40:0x42] = bytes([0x11, 0x40])  # MSI-X pointing at itself
    with pytest.raises(mmiotrace.ObserverUnavailable, match="MSI-X layout"):
        mmiotrace.msix_ranges(bytes(config))
    with pytest.raises(mmiotrace.ObserverUnavailable, match="shorter than 256"):
        mmiotrace.msix_ranges(bytes(64))


def test_msix_exclusion_matches_build_side_layout_parser():
    from pcileechfwgenerator.device_clone.msix_layout import read_msix_capability

    config = bytearray(256)
    config[0x06] = 0x10
    config[0x34] = 0x40
    config[0x40:0x42] = bytes([0x11, 0x00])
    config[0x42:0x44] = (64).to_bytes(2, "little")  # 65 entries
    config[0x44:0x48] = (0x2000 | 2).to_bytes(4, "little")
    config[0x48:0x4C] = (0x4000 | 2).to_bytes(4, "little")
    cap = read_msix_capability(bytes(config))
    assert mmiotrace.msix_ranges(bytes(config)) == [
        (2, 0x2000, 0x2000 + 16 * cap.table_size),
        (2, 0x4000, 0x4010),
    ]
```

```py
Uses the real ``pcileech_squirrel`` board from the voltcyclone-fpga submodule
as Stage 2 input. Generated memories and the generated controller are the
stock files plus a marker comment, so they are byte-distinct from stock
without inventing any donor identity.
"""

try:
    REPO = RepoManager.ensure_repo()
    BOARD_PATH = RepoManager.get_board_path(BOARD, repo_root=REPO)
    BOARD_XDC = RepoManager.get_xdc_files(BOARD, repo_root=REPO)
    _HAVE_BOARD = (BOARD_PATH / "ip" / CFGSPACE_COE).is_file()
except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - submodule absent
    REPO = BOARD_PATH = BOARD_XDC = None
    _HAVE_BOARD = False

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not _HAVE_BOARD, reason="voltcyclone-fpga submodule not initialized"
)


def _sha(data: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _generated(stock: Path, comment: str) -> str:
    """A byte-distinct generated variant of a stock artifact."""
    return f"{comment} {MARKER}\n" + stock.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def _generated_memories() -> dict:
    ip = BOARD_PATH / "ip"
    return {
        CFGSPACE_COE: _generated(ip / CFGSPACE_COE, ";"),
        WRITEMASK_COE: _generated(ip / WRITEMASK_COE, ";"),
    }


HOOK = "place_design_post.tcl"
HOOK_TEXT = "# post-placement hook staged by Stage 2\nputs hook\n"
CDC_TEXT = "# board CDC disposition checker\nputs CDC_CHECK_PASS\n"


def _stage2(
    out: Path, *, memories=None, write_override=True, hooks=(), cdc_check=False
) -> dict:
    """Assemble a Stage 2 output tree the way build.py does.

    Stock board IP is staged *first* (as the generator does), so the
    overlay has to replace stock COEs that are already present.
    """
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for sub in ("src", "ip", "constraints"):
        (out / sub).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for f in (BOARD_PATH / "ip").iterdir():
        if f.suffix in (".xci", ".coe"):
            shutil.copy2(f, out / "ip" / f.name)
    sources = []
    for f in (BOARD_PATH / "src").iterdir():
        if f.suffix in (".sv", ".svh", ".v"):
            shutil.copy2(f, out / "src" / f.name)
            sources.append(f.name)
    (out / "src" / CONTROLLER).write_text(
        _generated(BOARD_PATH / "src" / CONTROLLER, "//"), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    for f in BOARD_XDC:
        shutil.copy2(f, out / "constraints" / f.name)
    if write_override:
        (out / DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME).write_text(
            "# donor override emitted by Stage 2\n", encoding="utf-8"
        )
    memories = _generated_memories() if memories is None else memories
    hashes = stage_generated_memories(out, memories)
    for name in hooks:
        (out / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (out / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR / name).write_text(HOOK_TEXT, encoding="utf-8")
    if cdc_check:
        (out / CDC_CHECK_DIR).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (out / CDC_CHECK_DIR / CDC_CHECK_NAME).write_text(CDC_TEXT, encoding="utf-8")
    write_stage2_manifest(
        out,
        board=BOARD,
        sources=sources,
        ip_definitions=[p.name for p in (BOARD_PATH / "ip").glob("*.xci")],
        constraints=["pcileech_squirrel.xdc"],
        generated_memories=hashes,
        impl_hooks=hooks,
        cdc_check=cdc_check,
    )
    return hashes


def _forbid_stock_lookup(monkeypatch):
    """Fail if Stage 3 reaches into the board repository for design inputs."""

    def _boom(*_a, **_k):
        raise AssertionError("Stage 3 consulted the stock board repository")

    from pcileechfwgenerator.file_management.template_discovery import (
        TemplateDiscovery,
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(TemplateDiscovery, "get_source_files", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(TemplateDiscovery, "copy_board_templates", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pbi.RepoManager, "get_xdc_files", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pbi.RepoManager, "get_board_path", _boom)


@pytest.fixture
def no_stock_lookup(monkeypatch):
    _forbid_stock_lookup(monkeypatch)


def _integration(out: Path) -> PCILeechBuildIntegration:
    integ = PCILeechBuildIntegration(out, REPO)
    integ.get_available_boards()  # board metadata only, cached before guards
    return integ

def test_overlay_replaces_stock_memories_already_staged(tmp_path):
    hashes = _stage2(tmp_path)
    for name in (CFGSPACE_COE, WRITEMASK_COE):
        stock = sha256_file(BOARD_PATH / "ip" / name)
        assert hashes[name] != stock
        assert sha256_file(tmp_path / "ip" / name) == hashes[name]
        assert sha256_file(tmp_path / "src" / name) == hashes[name]
    manifest = validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)
    assert {CFGSPACE_COE, WRITEMASK_COE} <= set(manifest["ip"]["memories"])


def test_missing_cfgspace_memory_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match=CFGSPACE_COE):
        _stage2(tmp_path, memories={WRITEMASK_COE: "; x\n"})


def test_ip_referencing_ungenerated_writemask_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    memories = _generated_memories()
    del memories[WRITEMASK_COE]
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match=WRITEMASK_COE):
        _stage2(tmp_path, memories=memories)


def test_missing_override_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="override"):
        _stage2(tmp_path, write_override=False)


def test_missing_header_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    _stage2(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="pcileech_header.svh"):
        write_stage2_manifest(
            tmp_path,
            board=BOARD,
            sources=[CONTROLLER],
            ip_definitions=[p.name for p in (BOARD_PATH / "ip").glob("*.xci")],
            constraints=["pcileech_squirrel.xdc"],
            generated_memories={
                CFGSPACE_COE: sha256_file(tmp_path / "ip" / CFGSPACE_COE)
            },
        )


def test_no_staged_ip_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "ip").mkdir()
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="IP"):
        stage_generated_memories(tmp_path, _generated_memories())


def test_manifest_rejects_path_entries(tmp_path):
    _stage2(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="Invalid"):
        write_stage2_manifest(
            tmp_path,
            board=BOARD,
            sources=["pcileech_header.svh", "../escape.sv"],

            constraints=["pcileech_squirrel.xdc"],
            generated_memories={
                CFGSPACE_COE: sha256_file(tmp_path / "ip" / CFGSPACE_COE)
            },
        )

def test_stage3_builds_generated_not_stock(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup):
    hashes = _stage2(tmp_path)
    # Leftovers from an earlier run must not reach the project.
    (tmp_path / "src" / "stale_previous_run.sv").write_text("module stale; endmodule\n")
    shutil.copy2(tmp_path / "ip" / "pcie_7x_0.xci", tmp_path / "ip" / "stale_ip.xci")

    script = _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)
    board_dir = tmp_path / BOARD
    text = script.read_text()

    for name, digest in hashes.items():
        assert sha256_file(board_dir / "ip" / name) == digest
        assert digest != sha256_file(BOARD_PATH / "ip" / name)
    assert MARKER in (board_dir / "src" / CONTROLLER).read_text()

    assert "stale_previous_run" not in text
    assert "stale_ip" not in text
    assert not (board_dir / "src" / "stale_previous_run.sv").exists()
    assert "vivado_generate_project" not in text
    assert 'source "pcileech_donor_ip_overrides.tcl"' in text
    assert "WARNING: donor IP override script not found" not in text
    assert '[file normalize "ip/pcie_7x_0.xci"]' in text
    assert '[file normalize "ip/bram_pcie_cfgspace.xci"]' in text
    assert "glob -nocomplain -directory $ip_dir" not in text
    assert (
        'add_files -fileset constrs_1 -norecurse "constraints/pcileech_squirrel.xdc"'
        in text
    )


def test_stage3_without_manifest_does_not_fall_back(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup):
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="manifest not found"):
        _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)

def test_stage3_copy_failure_propagates(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup, monkeypatch):
    _stage2(tmp_path)

    def _fail(*_a, **_k):
        raise OSError("disk full")

    monkeypatch.setattr(pbi.shutil, "copy2", _fail)
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="disk full"):
        _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)


def test_stage_artifacts_in_place_is_not_copied(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    (tmp_path / "a.sv").write_text("module a; endmodule\n")
    integ = PCILeechBuildIntegration(tmp_path, REPO)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        pbi.shutil, "copy2", MagicMock(side_effect=AssertionError("copied onto itself"))
    )
    staged = integ._stage_artifacts(tmp_path, ["a.sv"], tmp_path, "source")
    assert staged == [tmp_path / "a.sv"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# build.py: real generator-to-build ordering
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _builder(out: Path) -> FirmwareBuilder:
    b = object.__new__(FirmwareBuilder)
    b.config = SimpleNamespace(output_dir=out, board=BOARD)
    b.logger = MagicMock()
    b.file_manager = FileOperationsManager(out, parallel=False, logger=b.logger)
    return b


def test_collect_memories_prefers_rendered_writemask():
    rendered = {CFGSPACE_COE: "; c\n", WRITEMASK_COE: "; rendered\n", "x.sv": "m"}
    got = FirmwareBuilder._collect_generated_memories(
        {
            "systemverilog_modules": rendered,
            "firmware_components": {"writemask_coe": "; component\n"},
        }
    )
    assert got == {CFGSPACE_COE: "; c\n", WRITEMASK_COE: "; rendered\n"}
    got = FirmwareBuilder._collect_generated_memories(
        {
            "systemverilog_modules": {CFGSPACE_COE: "; c\n"},
            "firmware_components": {"writemask_coe": "; component\n"},
        }
    )
    assert got[WRITEMASK_COE] == "; component\n"


def test_build_sequence_clean_directory_end_to_end(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Stock IP staged before modules are written still ends up generated."""
    out = tmp_path / "output"
    memories = _generated_memories()
    controller = _generated(BOARD_PATH / "src" / CONTROLLER, "//")
    # A COE left in src/ by a previous run must not survive either.
    (out / "src").mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy2(BOARD_PATH / "ip" / CFGSPACE_COE, out / "src" / CFGSPACE_COE)

    builder = _builder(out)
    result = {
        "systemverilog_modules": {CONTROLLER: controller, **memories},
        "firmware_components": {},
    }

    # Stage 2, in the generator's real order: board IP is staged during
    # generation, before the build writes modules.
    fm = FileManager(out)
    result["tcl_scripts"] = {p.name: str(p) for p in fm.copy_ip_files(BOARD)}
    assert sha256_file(out / "ip" / CFGSPACE_COE) == sha256_file(
        BOARD_PATH / "ip" / CFGSPACE_COE
    )
    builder._write_modules(result)
    assert (out / "src" / CFGSPACE_COE).read_text() == memories[CFGSPACE_COE]
    builder._staged_board_files = fm.copy_pcileech_sources(
        BOARD, generated=builder._generated_sources
    )
    (out / DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME).write_text("# donor override emitted by Stage 2\n")
    builder._finalize_stage2_artifacts(result)

    _forbid_stock_lookup(monkeypatch)  # Stage 3 from here on

    manifest = validate_stage2_artifacts(out, board=BOARD)
    assert manifest["generated_memories"] == {n: _sha(c) for n, c in memories.items()}
    assert CONTROLLER in manifest["sources"]
    assert MARKER in (out / "src" / CONTROLLER).read_text()

    _integration(out).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)
    for name, content in memories.items():
        assert (out / BOARD / "ip" / name).read_text() == content
    assert MARKER in (out / BOARD / "src" / CONTROLLER).read_text()
    assert (out / STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME).is_file()


def test_build_without_generated_memories_fails(tmp_path):
    out = tmp_path / "output"
    builder = _builder(out)
    builder._write_modules({"systemverilog_modules": {}})
    (out / "ip").mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy2(BOARD_PATH / "ip" / "bram_pcie_cfgspace.xci", out / "ip")
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match=CFGSPACE_COE):
        builder._finalize_stage2_artifacts({"systemverilog_modules": {}})


def test_override_failure_is_fatal(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from pcileechfwgenerator.vivado_handling import (
        fifo_donor_patcher,
        pcie_ip_donor_override,
    )

    builder = _builder(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        fifo_donor_patcher, "donor_ids_from_template_context", lambda _ctx: object()
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(fifo_donor_patcher, "apply_fifo_donor_patch", lambda *_a: {})
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        pcie_ip_donor_override, "donor_pcie_ip_config_from_result", lambda _r: None
    )

    def _fail(*_a, **_k):
        raise pcie_ip_donor_override.PcieIpOverrideError("cannot wire")

    monkeypatch.setattr(pcie_ip_donor_override, "apply_pcie_ip_donor_override", _fail)
    with pytest.raises(pcie_ip_donor_override.PcieIpOverrideError):
        builder._patch_fifo_with_donor_ids({"template_context": {}})


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "relative",
    [
        "src/pcileech_tlps128_bar_controller.sv",
        "ip/pcie_7x_0.xci",
        "constraints/pcileech_squirrel.xdc",
    ],
)
def test_stage2_rejects_input_changes_before_stage3(tmp_path, relative):
    _stage2(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / relative
    path.write_text(path.read_text() + "\n")
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="input changed"):
        _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Board implementation hooks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

HOOK_PROPERTY = (
    "set_property STEPS.PLACE_DESIGN.TCL.POST "
    '[file normalize "impl_hooks/place_design_post.tcl"] [get_runs impl_1]'
)


def test_stage3_attaches_recorded_impl_hook(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup):
    _stage2(tmp_path, hooks=[HOOK])
    manifest = validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)
    assert manifest["impl_hooks"] == [HOOK]
    assert f"{IMPL_HOOKS_DIR}/{HOOK}" in manifest["input_hashes"]

    text = _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD).read_text()
    staged = tmp_path / BOARD / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR / HOOK
    assert staged.read_text() == HOOK_TEXT
    assert HOOK_PROPERTY in text
    # Attached before the implementation run is launched.
    assert text.index(HOOK_PROPERTY) < text.index("launch_runs impl_1")


def test_stage3_without_hook_sets_no_step(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup):
    _stage2(tmp_path)
    assert validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)["impl_hooks"] == []
    text = _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD).read_text()
    assert "STEPS.PLACE_DESIGN.TCL.POST" not in text
    assert not (tmp_path / BOARD / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR).exists()


def test_impl_hook_changed_or_missing_after_stage2(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup):
    _stage2(tmp_path, hooks=[HOOK])
    hook = tmp_path / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR / HOOK
    hook.write_text(HOOK_TEXT + "phys_opt_design\n")
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="input changed"):
        _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)
    hook.unlink()
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="implementation hook"):
        _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)


def test_unknown_impl_hook_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="Unknown implementation hook"):
        _stage2(tmp_path, hooks=["route_design_post.tcl"])


def test_manifest_listing_unknown_hook_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    import json

    _stage2(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME
    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
    manifest["impl_hooks"] = ["evil.tcl"]
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="Unknown implementation hook"):
        validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)


def test_version1_manifest_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    import json

    _stage2(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME
    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
    manifest["version"] = 1
    del manifest["impl_hooks"]
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="Unsupported manifest format"):
        validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)


def test_stage2_copies_board_hook_into_manifest(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """A board that ships place_design_post.tcl reaches the Stage 3 script."""
    board_copy = tmp_path / "board"
    shutil.copytree(BOARD_PATH, board_copy)
    (board_copy / HOOK).write_text(HOOK_TEXT)
    (board_copy / "other_post.tcl").write_text("# not whitelisted\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(RepoManager, "get_board_path", lambda *_a, **_k: board_copy)
    out = tmp_path / "output"
    builder = _builder(out)
    result = {
        "systemverilog_modules": {
            CONTROLLER: _generated(BOARD_PATH / "src" / CONTROLLER, "//"),
            **_generated_memories(),
        },
        "firmware_components": {},
    }
    fm = FileManager(out)
    result["tcl_scripts"] = {p.name: str(p) for p in fm.copy_ip_files(BOARD)}
    builder._write_modules(result)
    builder._staged_board_files = fm.copy_pcileech_sources(
        BOARD, generated=builder._generated_sources
    )
    assert builder._staged_board_files["impl_hooks"] == [
        str(out / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR / HOOK)
    ]
    assert not (out / IMPL_HOOKS_DIR / "other_post.tcl").exists()
    (out / DONOR_IP_OVERRIDE_NAME).write_text("# donor override emitted by Stage 2\n")
    builder._finalize_stage2_artifacts(result)

    _forbid_stock_lookup(monkeypatch)
    assert validate_stage2_artifacts(out, board=BOARD)["impl_hooks"] == [HOOK]
    text = _integration(out).create_unified_build_script(BOARD).read_text()
    assert HOOK_PROPERTY in text


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Board CDC disposition checker
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

BLANKET_CDC = "Unqualified critical CDC findings"


@pytest.fixture
def pinned_cdc(monkeypatch):
    """Qualify the test checker text for the test board."""
    monkeypatch.setitem(pbi.QUALIFIED_CDC_CHECKER_SHA256, BOARD, _sha(CDC_TEXT))


def test_stage3_runs_recorded_board_cdc_checker(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup, pinned_cdc):
    _stage2(tmp_path, cdc_check=True)
    manifest = validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)
    assert manifest["cdc_check"] == CDC_CHECK_NAME
    assert f"{CDC_CHECK_DIR}/{CDC_CHECK_NAME}" in manifest["input_hashes"]

    text = _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD).read_text()
    assert (tmp_path / BOARD / CDC_CHECK_DIR / CDC_CHECK_NAME).read_text() == CDC_TEXT
    assert "cdc_check/check_cdc.tcl" in text and "^CDC_CHECK_PASS$" in text
    assert BLANKET_CDC not in text
    # Checked on the routed design, before the bitstream is written.
    assert text.index("routed_cdc.dcp") < text.index("-to_step write_bitstream")
    # XILINX_VIVADO is checked before synthesis starts.
    assert text.index("XILINX_VIVADO is not set") < text.index("launch_runs synth_1")
    inputs = json.loads((tmp_path / BOARD / "build_inputs.json").read_text())
    assert f"{CDC_CHECK_DIR}/{CDC_CHECK_NAME}" in {
        a["path"] for a in inputs["artifacts"]
    }


def test_stage3_without_board_checker_keeps_blanket_gate(tmp_path, no_stock_lookup):
    _stage2(tmp_path)
    assert validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)["cdc_check"] is None
    text = _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD).read_text()
    assert BLANKET_CDC in text and "routed_cdc.dcp" not in text


def test_board_cdc_checker_changed_or_missing_after_stage2(
    tmp_path, no_stock_lookup, pinned_cdc
):
    _stage2(tmp_path, cdc_check=True)
    checker = tmp_path / CDC_CHECK_DIR / CDC_CHECK_NAME
    checker.write_text("puts CDC_CHECK_PASS\nexit 0\n")
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="input changed"):
        _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)
    checker.unlink()
    with pytest.raises(BuildArtifactError, match="board CDC checker"):
        _integration(tmp_path).create_unified_build_script(BOARD)


def test_manifest_naming_other_cdc_checker_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    _stage2(tmp_path, cdc_check=True)
    path = tmp_path / STAGE2_MANIFEST_NAME
    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
    manifest["cdc_check"] = "evil.tcl"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))

        validate_stage2_artifacts(tmp_path, board=BOARD)


def test_shipped_100t_checker_is_copied(tmp_path):
    board = RepoManager.get_board_path("pcileech_100t484_x1", repo_root=REPO)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    copied = FileManager(out).copy_pcileech_sources("pcileech_100t484_x1")
```
